abstract_ko:
본 발명은 고층건물에 화재나 지진, 건물붕괴 등과 같은 긴급 상황이 발생할 경우 건물의 외벽을 따라 신속하게 승강이동하여 안전하게 인명을 구조하여 재난으로 부터 인명피해의 최소화를 도모하는데 크게 일조할 수 있는 새로운 형태의 초고층 건물의 인명구조용 엘리베이터 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     	즉, 고층건물 옥상의 일측에 일정한 길이의 와이어를 좌우방향으로 선회 작동할 수 있는 와이어 좌우 선회장치와; 그 일측에 일정한 길이의 가이드레일과; 상기 가이드레일과 선회장치 와이어의 선회작동에 따라 좌우 일정간격 이동이 자유롭고 엘리베이터의 리프팅 매개체인 상하 리프팅 안내용 와이어가 권설된 엘리베이터 구동장치와; 상기 엘리베이터 구동장치에 권설된 상태에서 건물의 하방 지면으로 두 가닥 늘어뜨려져 엘리베이터의 리프팅 매개로 작용하는 엘리베이터 상, 하 리프팅 안내용 와이어와; 상기 건물바닥으로 하향 늘어뜨려진 두 줄의 상, 하 리프팅 안내용 와이어에 선택 장착된 상태에서 그 와이어를 타고 스스로 리프팅 구동하면서 필요한 건물 외벽위치로 이동하여 인명 구조할 수 있도록 하는 와이어리프팅 구동장치를 가진 구조용 엘리베이터; 를 포함하여 이루어지는 것이다. 
       
     	와이어, 구동모터, 가이드레일, 엘리베이터, 끼움홈, 보조커버, 힌지핀

title_en: Gas inflatable type lifesaving safety mat
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가스인플레이트에 의해 안전매트에 신속하게 공기를 주입시켜 팽창되게 하여 미숙련자도 손쉽게 설치가 가능하고 고층건물의 화재나 비상시에 떨어지는 낙하자를 용이하게 구조할 수 있는 가스팽창식 인명구조 안전매트에 관한 것으로, 공기가 주입되어 팽창되면서 펼쳐지는 매트 본체와, 상기 매트 본체의 측부에 연결되어 매트 본체로 공기를 주입시키는 가스인플레이터와, 상기 매트 본체의 내부에 구비되어 충격을 완충할 수 있도록 하는 충격완충부와, 상기 충격완충부의 상부로 덮여져 충격을 흡수하는 매트 상판과, 상기 매트 본체의 상부 외측에 구비되어 매트 본체를 이동시킬 수 있는 이동부를 포함한다.

title_en: Method for quickly identifying post-earthquake structural damage based on flexibility change rate and pattern matching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly identifying post-earthquake structural damage based on flexibility change rate and pattern matching, which comprises the following steps of: establishing a finite element model of the structure, and carrying out modal analysis on various damage working conditions; calculating the flexibility change rate of the injury to form an injury mode library; carrying out modal identification on the structure dynamic response, and calculating a matching vector to form a test set; and (5) carrying out similarity measurement on the matching vectors in the test set and a pattern library in sequence, and judging the damage position and the damage degree according to the matching result. The method has the advantages of small calculation amount and high calculation speed; the influence of excitation can be eliminated, so that the established damage mode library is not influenced by external environmental factors; the damage position and the damage degree can be efficiently and quickly identified, and the defect that the damage degree cannot be quantified by the traditional method for identifying the structural damage based on the flexibility matrix is overcome. Therefore, the method is suitable for the post-earthquake damage and safety evaluation of the structure, and has great significance for emergency rescue and emergency decision after earthquake.

title_en: Graded power propulsion system and propulsion device for tunneling type lifesaving passage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine rescue, in particular to a grading power propulsion system and a propulsion device for a tunneling rescue channel, which solve the problems that the supporting mechanism of the existing tunneling rescue machine in the prior art is inconvenient to adjust the angle, and after the mine collapses, if the position of the mine is deeper to be rescued, the rescue team is combined with a rescue instrument to enter the collapse, a great amount of time is needed, so that time and labor are wasted, and secondary collapse is possibly encountered in the rescue process, and the secondary injury is caused. The utility model provides a tunneling type life saving passageway is with hierarchical power propulsion system and advancing device, includes tunneling mechanism, pushing mechanism, adjustment mechanism and sediment mechanism, and tunneling mechanism includes bottom support frame. The invention improves the convenience of installation, thereby greatly improving the rescue efficiency, facilitating the splicing and prolonging of the tunneling depth, facilitating the realization of automatic propulsion and crushing and improving the rescue efficiency.
assignees: JIANGSU TIANDUN HEAVY INDUSTRY MACHINERY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real-time early warning method for secondary collapse risk of RC frame semi-ruin structure after earthquake
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of earthquake on-site rescue and early warning, in particular to a real-time early warning method for secondary collapse risk of a ruin structure of an RC frame. The method comprises 4 modules, wherein the module 1 is used for realizing the whole process of the RC frame structure from intact to ruins and then to secondary collapse through simulating a main-aftershock effect by using a seismic simulation vibrating table, the module 2 is used for processing the structural dynamic response time course data by adopting a high-dimensional continuous transverse moving time window method and obtaining dynamic response characteristics of the RC frame semi-ruins secondary collapse structure, the module 3 is used for clustering the secondary collapse risk type of the RC frame semi-ruins structure by using a K-Means machine learning algorithm, and the module 4 is used for realizing real-time early warning of the secondary collapse risk of the RC frame semi-ruins structure by using Informer machine learning algorithm. The invention can scientifically and accurately judge and predict the risk of secondary collapse of the RC frame ruin structure under the aftershock.

title_en: Safety Diagnosis System for Underground
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety diagnosis system for an underground working space which comprises: a gateway installed on a lower portion of a manhole cover to communicate with the outside through Wi-Fi communication and Bluetooth communication; an environment sensor which is installed in the working space and configured to be changed from a sleep mode to a wake-up mode when an operation signal is transmitted from the gateway through the Bluetooth communication to detect at least one of the environment states of gas detection, carbon dioxide detection, temperature and humidity detection, and immersion detection in the working space, and to transmit the environment state to the gateway; and a worker terminal with an application installed therein to provide a worker with environment state information provided by the environment sensor. The gateway performs the Bluetooth communication with the worker terminal when the worker terminal, in which the application is run, enters within a reference distance, generates the operation signal for changing the environment sensor from the sleep mode to the wake-up mode, and transmits the operation signal to the environment sensor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하 작업공간에 대한 안전진단 시스템에 관한 것으로, 맨홀 뚜껑의 하부에 설치되어 와이파이 통신과 블루투스 통신으로 외부와 통신하는 게이트웨이; 작업공간 내에 설치되고, 블루투스 통신을 통해 상기 게이트웨이로부터 동작신호가 전송될 때 슬립 모드에서 웨이크업 모드로 변경되어 작업공간 내의 가스감지, 이산화탄소감지, 온습도감지, 및 침수감지 중 적어도 어느 하나의 환경상태를 감지하여 상기 게이트웨이로 전송하는 환경센서; 및 상기 환경센서에서 제공하는 환경상태정보를 작업자에게 제공하는 앱이 설치된 작업자 단말기를 포함하고, 상기 게이트웨이는 상기 앱이 구동된 작업자 단말기가 기준 거리 이내로 진입될 때 상기 작업자 단말기와 블루투스 통신을 수행한 후 상기 환경센서를 슬립 모드에서 웨이크업 모드로 변경시키기 위한 동작신호를 생성하여 환경센서로 전송하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Intelligent protection method and system for fire extinguishing protective clothing based on impact mechanics analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire protection equipment, and discloses an intelligent protection method and system for fire protection clothing based on impact mechanics analysis, wherein the intelligent protection method and system comprise the steps of quantifying main frequency energy of sound waves, heat radiation intensity and human impact force vector, and constructing an environment risk portrait; the method comprises the steps of carrying out grading treatment on different types of data, calculating a human body injury risk index, a collapse risk index and a secondary collapse probability to generate a collaborative threat grading table, monitoring firefighter physiological state data in real time, triggering protection actions according to threat grades and response priorities, dynamically generating a physiological-environment linkage instruction set, detecting high risk positions and triggering conditions through mapping of group topological coordinates and risk areas, generating a directional defense instruction and driving a touch vibration array, synchronously recording group protection execution logs, and dynamically correcting threat grade thresholds, linkage instruction strategies, touch feedback parameters and calculation accuracy of threat indexes in the threat grading table.
assignees: U PROTEC SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Shore Protection Revetments of Hydrophilic with Capacity of Wave Dissipating
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 해안, 하천, 호수, 물량장 등에 사용하여 사람들이 수변에 원활하게 접근할 수 있으며, 바다의 파도나 물량장 등에서 발생하는 항주파, 호수내의 파랑에 의한 제방의 붕괴, 유속에 의한 하천 제방 등의 유실을 방지하기 위한 소파 성능이 내재된 친수호안블록에 관한 것이다.  
     하천이나 해안에 설치되는 콘크리트 구조물로서 사람들의 문화생활 향상에 따른 수변이나 해안의 접근성을 향상시키기 위한 구조물로 하천의 제방 보호 및 해안의 제방보호를 주된 목적으로 한다. 종래의 유사한 구조물들은 단순 법면 보호기능 위주로 개발 보급되고 있는 사항이나 본 발명은 제방보호와 사람들이 안전하게 물가에 접근할 수 있는 구조로 되며 본 발명 블록의 시공시 기초블록, 기본블록, 마감블록으로 구성되어 기초단부터 상부마감까지 서로 교차되게 적층되는 구조로 기초지반 부실에 의한 부등침하 저항성을 향상시키며 블록의 하단부에 설치된 돌출 구조들을 이용하여 공극률을 극대화시켜 해안이나 하천, 호수 등의 파랑이나 태풍, 해일 등의 발생시 제방에 진입하는 파의 에너지를 감쇄시켜 월파방지를 최소화하며 또한 파 에너지에 의한 연안침식을 최소화시킬 수 있으며 선착장이나 물량장 등에 설치 시 선박의 주행에 의해 발생되는 항주파를 최소화하여 소형 선박 등의 계류가 보다 안전할 수 있도록 파력과 유속 등의 힘을 분산시킬 수 있다. 
       
     기초블록, 기본블록, 마감블록, 고정홈, 차수벽, 유공부, 천단블록, 감세부, 돌출부

title_en: System for saving a life and information transmission by collapse of structure
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system, for transmitting lifesaving information due to collapse of building structure, which detects collapse of the building structure, detects existence of human who cannot evacuate, and transmits the status of collapse of the building structure and the existence of human to people who are in concern, emergency rescue agencies and rescue workers when earthquake, external shock or fire occurs within the building structure in which people work or rest. More particularly, the present invention relates to a system for transmitting lifesaving information due to collapse of building structure which includes: a vibration detection unit; a human detection unit; a collapse detection unit; a data transmission unit for converting data detected in the collapse detection unit into a signal and transmitting to a data collection and analysis unit wherein the data collection and analysis unit generates a collapse reference by analyzing the transmitted signal, determining the collapse of the building structure using the collapse reference and existence of human, and transmitting the information to a communications service provider web application server wherein the communications service provider server transmits the collapse of the building structure and existence of human to emergency rescue agencies and rescue workers, and people who are in concern with the building structure in real time, thereby helping rapid lifesaving and understanding the safety and security of people who are in concern with the building structure.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사람들이 내부에서 업무 또는 휴식을 취하는 건축구조물에 지진, 외부충격, 화재가 발생할 경우 상기 건축구조물의 붕괴 여부를 감지하고 상기 건축구조물 내부에 대피하지 못한 사람의 유무를 감지하여 상기 건축구조물에 관련된 사람들과 구조기관, 구조대원들에게 상기 건축구조물의 붕괴 상황 및 사람의 존재 유무 상황을 전달할 수 있는 건축구조물의 붕괴에 따른 인명 구조 정보 전달 시스템에 관한 것으로 보다 상세하게는 진동 감지부와 인체 감지부와 붕괴 감지부에서 감지한 데이터를 데이터 전송부에서 신호로 변환하여 데이터 수집 분석부에 전송하며 상기 데이터 수집 분석부는 전송된 신호를 분석하여 붕괴 기준을 생성하고, 상기 붕괴 기준을 통해 건축구조물의 붕괴 유무 및 사람의 존재 유무를 판단하여 통신사 웹 어플리케이션 서버에 전송하며, 상기 통신사 웹 어플리케이션 서버는 상기 건축구조물의 붕괴 유무 및 사람의 존재 유무를 구조기관 및 구조대원들과 상기 건축구조물과 관련된 사람들에게 실시간으로 전송하여 신속한 인명 구조 및 상기 건축구조물과 관련된 사람들의 안전을 미리 파악할 수 있는 건축구조물의 붕괴에 따른 인명 구조 정보전달 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: floor indefendent type firefighting unit and floor indefendent type firefighting system using the same
title_ko: 건물 층별 소화유니트 및 이를 적용한 건물 층간 독립형 소방시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물 층별 소화유니트 및 이를 적용한 건물 층간 독립형 소방시스템에 관한 것으로서, 건물 층별 소화유니트는 건물의 해당 층에 독립되게 마련되며 소방수를 저수공간에 가압상태로 저장하는 가압탱크와, 가압탱크가 설치된 층에 마련된 소화수 분사용 노즐로부터 상기 가압탱크와 연통되게 마련된 공급관로에 설치되어 공급 제어신호에 따라 상기 공급관로를 개폐하는 개폐밸브가 마련된 소화수 공급부와, 소화수 공급부가 설치된 층에 장착된 화재감지기로부터 화재감지신호가 수신되면 개폐밸브가 개방되게 제어하여 가압탱크에 저수된 소화수가 노즐을 통해 분사되게 처리하는 단말제어부를 구비한다. 이러한 건물 층별 소화유니트 및 이를 적용한 건물 층간 독립형 소방시스템에 의하면, 지진과 같은 재난상황 발생에 의해 일부 층이 붕괴되거나 상용전원의 공급이 차단되더라도 층별로 자체 화재 감지 및 진화처리를 독립적으로 수행할 수 있어 재난 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: High-resolution remote sensing image post-earthquake building detection method based on sparse dictionary
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sparse dictionary-based high-resolution remote sensing image post-earthquake building detection method. Belongs to the field of remote sensing and photogrammetry; the method comprises the following specific steps: 1. extracting a potential building set and constructing a multi-feature earthquake damage visual dictionary; 2. constructing a context relation based on spatial pixels in a visual dictionary; 3. the sparse expression of the visual dictionary can realize more detailed expression of the characteristics of the original image; 4. and obtaining a final detection result through earthquake damage building detection based on SVM classification. After an earthquake occurs, the method can quickly and accurately judge the position of the earthquake-damaged building, and has important effects on carrying out emergency rescue and disaster assessment after the earthquake; the method is characterized in that a plurality of groups of high-resolution remote sensing images after the earthquake in different areas and different sensors are tested; meanwhile, through further division of intact buildings, partial earthquake-damaged buildings and ruins in detection results, key decision support can be provided for emergency response rescue after earthquake and reconstruction after disaster.

title_en: Buried person search device using detachable module
title_ko: 분리형 모듈을 활용한 매몰자 탐색 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a shipwrecked person detecting device at a collapse disaster site, and more specifically, to a buried person searching device using a detachable module. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the buried person searching device using a detachable module comprises: a ground drone (10) deployed at the collapse disaster site, traveling by driving a track device (20), and equipped with a communication device (80) and a first beacon; a camera device (40) mounted on the ground drone (10) to photograph the front, rear, left and right sides, and top of the ground drone (10); a storage (50) installed on the ground drone (10), storing a repeater module (60), and throwing the repeater module (60) at the collapse disaster site according to an operation signal; a plurality of repeater modules (60) connected to a wireless communication network to relay wireless communication between the ground drone (10), a flying drone (32), and a command and control unit (100) and equipped with a second beacon; and a detection device (70) installed on the ground drone (10) or the repeater module (60) to collect human breathing sounds, voice sounds, mobile phone sounds, and artificial rhythm sounds. According to the present invention, it is possible to more clearly determine whether someone needs help, and if so, where and in what situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 붕괴 재난 현장의 조난자 탐지 장치 더욱 구체적으로 분리형 모듈을 활용한 매몰자 탐색 장치는, 붕괴 재난 현장에 투입되어 궤도 장치(20)의 구동으로 주행하고 통신 장치(80)와 제1 비컨(Beacon)이 탑재된 지상 드론(10); 지상 드론(10)에 탑재되어 지상 드론(10)의 전후방, 좌우 측방 및 상방을 촬영하는 카메라 장치(40); 지상 드론(10)에 설치되고 중계기 모듈(60)을 수납하며 작동 신호에 따라 중계기 모듈(60)을 붕괴 재난 현장에 투척하는 스토리지(50); 무선 통신망으로 연결되어 지상 드론(10), 비행 드론(32) 및 지휘 통제부(100) 간에 무선 통신을 중계하고 제2 비컨(Beacon)이 탑재된 다수의 중계기 모듈(60); 및 지상 드론(10) 또는 중계기 모듈(60)에 설치되어 인체 숨소리, 육성, 휴대전화기 소리 및 인위적 리듬 소리를 수집하는 감지 장치(70); 을 포함한다.

title_en: Fire rescue that can install fast is with preventing device that collapses
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a collapse prevention device for fire rescue, which can be quickly installed and solves the technical problem that secondary collapse is easily caused due to the fact that a corresponding supporting and stabilizing device is not available in the existing ditch rescue. The device comprises a first baffle plate, a second baffle plate and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the first baffle plate and the second baffle plate are used for supporting soil bodies on two sides of a ditch; the adjusting mechanism comprises a first rotating telescopic rod movably connected with the first baffle, a second rotating telescopic rod movably connected with the second baffle, and a fixed telescopic sleeve for movably sleeving the first rotating telescopic rod and the second rotating telescopic rod. The utility model adopts the adjusting mechanism which can reasonably adjust the supporting distance between the two baffles according to ditches with different widths, and in order to avoid the support collapse caused by the pressure of soil bodies on two sides on the baffles in the rescue process, the utility model is also provided with the fixing mechanism for stabilizing the distance between the two baffles, so the application is stable and safe.

title_en: System and method for notifying of dangerous situation in building
title_ko: 건물 위험 상황 통지 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for notifying a building manager or an occupant of a hazardous situation by detecting a hazardous situation such as accident, fire, collapse, explosion, break-in and the like occurring in a building and a method thereof. The system for notifying a hazardous situation according an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a detecting apparatus for judging a disaster situation by collecting environment information inside a building, and for transmitting disaster information to a relay apparatus; the relay apparatus for receiving the disaster information transmitted from the detecting apparatus, transmitting the received disaster information to a server, and outputting access point (AP) signals; the server for receiving the disaster information transmitted from the relay apparatus, generating a service set identifier (SSID) list by searching disaster-occurred building information, manager information, user information and an SSID corresponding to an AP of the relay apparatus installed at the disaster-occurred location, based on the received disaster information, and transmitting a push message including the SSID list to a mobile terminal of a user based on the user information; and the mobile terminal for starting wireless communication, detecting the AP signals, and judging whether a hazardous situation occurs by comparing the SSID of the detected AP signals and the SSID list, when the push message is received.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물에서 발생하는 재해, 화재, 붕괴, 폭발 및 침입 등의 위험 상황을 감지하고 위험상황정보를 건물 관리자 또는 재실자에게 통지하는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 하나의 실시예에 따르면 위험 상황 통지 시스템은 건물 내부의 환경정보를 수집하여 재난 상황을 판단하고 재난정보를 중계장치로 전송하는 감지장치, 감지장치로부터 전송되는 재난정보를 수신하고 수신된 재난정보를 서버로 전송하며 AP(Access Point) 신호를 출력하는 중계장치, 중계장치로부터 전송되는 재난정보를 수신하고 수신된 재난정보에 기초하여 재난 발생 건물정보, 관리자정보, 이용자정보, 그리고 재난 발생 위치에 설치되어 있는 중계장치의 AP에 대응하는 SSID(Service Set IDentifier)를 검색하여 SSID 리스트를 생성하고, 이용자정보에 기초하여 이용자의 모바일 단말로 SSID 리스트를 포함하는 푸시 메시지를 전송하는 서버, 그리고 푸시 메시지가 수신되는 경우 무선통신을 개시하고 AP 신호를 감지하며 감지된 AP 신호의 SSID와 SSID 리스트를 비교하여 위험상황 발생 여부를 판단하는 모바일 단말을 포함한다.

title_en: Search and rescue robot for building collapse
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot for building collapse, which comprises a robot main body, wherein crawler wheels are arranged on two sides of the robot main body, a rotating base is arranged on the outer side wall of the upper end of the robot main body, a cantilever is arranged on the rotating base, a cutting mechanism is arranged at the end part of the cantilever, when the cutting mechanism cuts concrete, water can be sprayed to cool the cutting mechanism, when a cutting saw blade performs high-power cutting, simple spraying water can not meet the cooling requirement of the cutting saw blade, the spraying water can be adjusted in a self-adaptive manner, the cooling requirement of the cutting saw blade is met, in addition, the cooling liquid on the upper side of a liquid storage cavity can be mixed with water in the spraying water in a self-adaptive manner when the cutting saw blade performs high-power cutting, the cooling effect of the water mixed with the cooling liquid is better, the cooling effect of the cutting saw blade can be further improved, and the efficiency of the cutting saw blade during search and rescue cutting can be ensured.
assignees: HANGZHOU TIANHAIXIANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building a smart university safety campus using safety booths
title_ko: 안심부스를 이용한 스마트한 대학 안전 캠퍼스 구축
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the construction of a safe campus of a smart university using a safety booth, which can recognize a situation of a criminal or evacuee inside and outside a safety booth. The safety booth for criminal prevention and emergency rescue, comprises: a safety booth installed to be spaced apart from each other at a dangerous area; a roof of the safety booth; a glass and a door of the safety booth; an emergency door lock installed on the door; a control center; a rim and a receiving means; a CCTV or camera, Wi-Fi, and warning light; and a fixed chair.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일측면은 범죄예방 및 긴급구조 안전부스를 이용하여 여성 및 노약자, 어린이 등이 안전부스를 통해 신속하게 격리시켜 범죄자로부터 부터 긴급구조 요청함과 동시에 안전을 제공하여 범죄예방을 방지하기 위한 안전부스; 상기 안전부스의 지붕; 상기 안전부스의 유리 및 도어문; 상기 도어문에 설치된 비상도어락; 상기 복수개 안전부스와 유무선 및 영상통신이 가능하고, 대피자와 동시에 유무선 및 영상통화가 가능한 관제센터; 상기 관제센터에 의해 상기 복수개 안전부스 위치와 비상상황을 구조자에게 실시간으로 알려주고 출동하는 알림 및 수신수단; 상기 안전부스에 장착된 CCTV 또는 카메라, 와이파이, 경광등; 및 상기 안전부스 내부에 구비된 CCTV 또는 카메라, 공중전화기, 비상벨, 스마트 미디어기, 긴급통화 장치, 비대면 ATM, AED. 함체형 탈착식 들것, 냉난방기, 고정식 의자;을 포함하고, 대피자가 상기 안전부스 내부에 장착된 상기 비상벨을 누를 경우, 상기 도어문의 비상도어락, 경과등 및 사이렌이 작동되고, 상기 비상벨의 신호는 관제센터에 송신되어서 관제요원 긴급출동중에도 구조자가 대피자에게 응급상황과 대처지시를 하면서 대피자를 구조;하고, 상기 비상벨의 해제 누를 경우 상황이 종료;되게 구성되고, 또한 상기 유리 및 도어문은, 강화유리로 이루어지면서 대피자가 비상벨을 작동할 경우 상기 도어문이 작동되어 잠겨지게 구성될 수 있고, 상기 CCTV 또는 카메라는, 상기 안전부스의 안밖의 범죄사 또는 대피자의 상황을 파악하거나, 상기 안전부스 내부의 대피자의 응급상황을 대처할 수 있도록 포함되게 구성되어 있다.
assignees: GANGNEUNG YEONGDONG COLLEGE IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Intelligent dialogue platform for building industry
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent dialogue platforms, in particular to an intelligent dialogue platform for building industry, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a man-machine interaction module, an image acquisition module, a data analysis module, a three-dimensional modeling module, a data storage module, a cloud server and a control management module; the method comprises the steps of repairing a damaged building according to a shot damaged building picture and text data uploaded by a user, drawing a three-dimensional model, displaying repairing reasons and repairing concepts in a text mode by a platform, and adjusting unsatisfied positions on the three-dimensional model of the platform by the user through uploading the picture and the text, so that people can repair the damaged ancient building conveniently, the ancient building can be protected better, or a collapsed building in a natural disaster can be repaired, and rescue workers can know the building structure as soon as possible and rescue can be implemented.
assignees: JINAN HUIGU DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue system for building collapse
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue system for collapse of a building, which comprises a framework system and a control system, wherein the framework system comprises a plurality of fixed frames, each fixed frame comprises stand columns perpendicular to the ground and fixed cross beams perpendicular to the stand columns, the stand columns and the fixed cross beams are at least four, the stand columns are arranged in a rectangular mode, two ends of each fixed cross beam are connected to the top ends of two adjacent stand columns, the top of each fixed frame is provided with a plurality of movable cross beams capable of moving along the X-axis direction, the control system comprises a control room, the control room is arranged on the movable cross beams and can move along the Z-axis direction, a motor, a control panel and an accommodating space are arranged in the control room, an iron hook capable of moving along the Y-axis direction is arranged at the bottom of the control room, and the motor is connected with a power supply. The rescue system provided by the invention has the advantages of small required open area, no limit on height, large rescue surface coverage and high rescue efficiency, and can efficiently rescue the life bodies and effectively reduce casualties.

title_en: Earthquake and collapse building rescue waste residue transferring equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses earthquake and collapse building rescue waste residue transfer equipment, which solves the problem that a conveying device in the prior art cannot be suitable for building collapse or earthquake rescue sites. The earthquake and collapse building rescue waste residue transfer equipment comprises a linear conveying assembly, a turning conveying assembly, a supporting assembly for supporting the linear conveying assembly and the turning conveying assembly to leave the ground, a connecting assembly matched with the linear conveying assembly and the turning conveying assembly, and a mobile power supply for supporting the linear conveying assembly and the turning conveying assembly to supply power; the supporting straight line conveying components, the turning conveying components or the supporting straight line conveying components and the turning conveying components are connected through connecting components. According to the invention, the linear conveying assembly, the turning conveying assembly, the supporting assembly, the mobile power supply and the connecting assembly are matched for use, and the linear conveying assembly and the turning conveying assembly can be assembled according to the field environment, so that waste residues can be conveyed conveniently, and the cleaning speed of a rescue channel is improved.

title_en: Dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure safety risk assessment method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure safety risk assessment method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of constructing a finite element simulation model of a dam and a Bayesian network of the dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure; searching a damage path in the finite element simulation model by adopting a flood discharge energy dissipation structure damage criterion; calculating the damage probability p  o  of each structural damage mode by adopting a Monte Carlo method according to the risk agent model, the mechanical parameters of the dam and foundation materials and the hydraulic parameters of the overflow surface; calculating the structural system damage probability p  α  of the flood discharge energy dissipation structure; when any damaged path o is assumed to be absent, calculating damage probability of flood discharge energy dissipation structure when disaster factors of damaged path o are not damaged based on the rest damaged paths and Bayesian network ; According to p  α  and Calculating the importance of disaster factors of the damaged path o; and selecting a failure path corresponding to the disaster causing factor with the highest importance as a main control path for destroying the flood discharging and energy dissipating structure.

title_en: Prediction method for highest temperature and position of fire roof of underground inclined tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prediction method for the highest temperature and the position of a fire roof of an underground inclined tunnel, belongs to the technical field of tunnel fire safety, and solves the problem that the error of the determination method for the highest temperature and the position of the highest temperature of the fire roof of the inclined tunnel in the prior art is large. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the fire early warning capability is improved, the fire source position can be effectively identified by accurately predicting the highest temperature and the position of the ceiling when the fire occurs in the inclined tunnel, important references are provided for rescue workers, and the timeliness and the accuracy of fire emergency response are enhanced. The method reduces structural damage, predicts the highest temperature of the ceiling and the position of the ceiling, can take protective measures in time or in advance, reduces damage of fire to the tunnel structure, and prolongs the service life of the tunnel.

title_en: Portable quick-demolition device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable quick-demolition device comprising a hand-operated hydraulic pump, a shearing clamp, an expander and a jacking device. The shearing clamp, the expander and the jacking device adopt the hydraulic drive, and are respectively connected to the hand-operated hydraulic pump by quick-changed joints. The utility model provides the portable quick-demolition device, which only depends on the human power, is light-weighted, and is convenient to carry and operate. The shearing clamp, the expander and the jacking device can be alternatively used to save lives at the scenes of car, railway accidents, air crashes, geological disasters, building collapses, and beach rescues. The quick-demolition device is the ideal tool for the public security, the fire-fighting, and the mine emergency rescues.

title_en: System for rescuing distress of human life by collapse and fire
title_ko: 붕괴 및 화재에 따른 인명 조난 구조 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for rescuing people when a collapse or fire occurs is provided to minimize the number of victims by determining whether a person exists inside a building in which the collapse or fire occurs. CONSTITUTION: An acceleration sensor (110) measures vibrations affected to a building when an earthquake occurs or an external impact is applied. An inclination sensor (120) measures a change in an inclination angle of the building. An analog-to-digital (A/D) converting unit (140) converts analog data filtered in a band-pass filter into digital data. A human body sensing unit (300) detects an infrared ray generated from a human body and senses existence of a person inside the building. A data analyzing unit (400) determines whether a person exists inside the building. [Reference numerals] (100) Collapse detection unit; (110) Acceleration sensor; (120) Inclination sensor; (130) Band pass filter; (140) A/D converting unit; (200) Smoke detection unit; (300) Human body sensing unit; (400) Data analyzing unit; (500) Warning alarm unit; (600) Power supply unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사람들이 내부에서 업무 또는 휴식을 취하는 건축물에 지진, 외부 충격, 화재가 발생할 경우 건축물 내부에 미처 대피하지 못한 사람의 유무를 감지하고 붕괴로 인한 매몰자 및 화재로 인한 질식자를 감지하여 구조대원에게 구조요청을 할 수 있도록 경보 및 구조요청 신호를 전달하는 것으로 상기 건축물에 발생하는 붕괴와 화재를 붕괴 감지부와 화재 감지부를 통해 감지하고, 상기 건축물의 내부에 사람이 존재할 경우 인체 감지부를 통해 사람의 유무를 감지하여 건축물의 붕괴 또는 화재 발생 시 구조대원들이 휴대하고 있는 구조 요청 단말기에 붕괴 또는 화재 발생 신호를 전송하고 인체 감지부를 통해 사람의 유무 감지 시 사람이 있다고 판단할 경우 붕괴로 인해 발생한 매몰자 또는 화재에 따른 연기 질식자가 있음을 구조 요청 단말기에 전송하여 상기 건축물의 붕괴 및 화재 발생 시 구조대원들이 매몰자 또는 질식자를 신속하게 구조할 수 있는 붕괴 및 화재에 따른 인명 조난 구조 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Elastic continuous road pavement structure with nano-cracks
abstract_en: As part of the search for innovative and sustainable solutions for the design and construction of road pavement, the present invention consists of a continuous structure that challenges conventional maintenance paradigms. The design of the invention, which is based on an elastic and disruptive mechanistic approach, incorporates nano-cracks to improve the strength and durability of the pavement. The invention uses H30 reinforced concrete with A630-420H steel in a central mesh. This pavement is suited to different levels of traffic by means of the variation in the thickness and reinforcement of frameworks, which are installed on a continuous levelling H5 concrete grid, having a thickness that varies depending on the characteristics of the subgrade, ensuring a pavement-ground structure with structural integrity. This approach also includes features such as chamfers on the surface that prevents the edge from breaking due to the load of road traffic, ensuring its structural integrity under different traffic conditions and not requiring maintenance. In 2011, the first generation (1G) invention patent CL47.313 (José Pablo Fernández, 03 November 2008) was granted for a continuous pavement structure with an elastic and disruptive mechanistic design with nano-cracks, in ports, airports and roads, with a double continuous upper and lower mesh, and reinforcing bars at the edges. To date, a third generation invention patent has been applied for which relates to a continuous road pavement structure with a disruptive and elastic mechanistic design with nano-cracks, which is more efficient with a central mesh having a longitudinal framework at 100 mm and a transverse framework at 200 mm, and without reinforcing bars at the edges, for average traffic with a pavement thickness of 100 mm. The invention is used as a firebreak that prevents fire propagation and allows evacuation and access for rescuers and firefighters.

title_en: Positioning system and method for emergency networking in disaster area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a positioning system and a method for emergency networking in a disaster area, belonging to the technical field of communication positioning. The system comprises a GNSS data module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the GNSS data module is used for acquiring coordinate data of a peripheral reference point of a disaster area and providing reference coordinate data for UWB emergency networking in the disaster area; the UWB emergency networking module is used for establishing UWB emergency networking in a disaster area according to the reference coordinate data; the UWB mobile tag positioning module is used for acquiring positioning data of UWB emergency networking in a disaster area; the data calculation module is used for calculating the position information of the rescuers according to the positioning data of the UWB emergency networking and the reference coordinate data; and the monitoring end display module is used for receiving the position information of the rescue workers and displaying the positions of the rescue workers in real time. The invention solves the problem that rescue workers cannot be accurately positioned due to the fact that the quality of communication signals cannot be guaranteed in a disaster site of building collapse in the prior art.

title_en: Passive disconnect-type snake-like robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a passive separation type snake-shaped robot, which comprises a head, a control unit, an external environment detection unit and a battery unit, wherein the head comprises a head shell, and the control unit, the external environment detection unit and the battery unit are arranged on the head shell; the body part comprises a plurality of separable joint modules which are sequentially connected to form a chain structure and joint driving motors arranged between every two adjacent separable joint modules; the separable joint module comprises a module I, a module II and a connecting assembly; when the building collapses and is pressed by gravity, the pressed part stops moving, the part which is not pressed continues moving to transmit power, so that the spring in the connecting device drives the steel ball to be separated from the spherical groove, the pressed part is separated from the whole body to stop working, the part which is not pressed continues working under the leading of the snake head, and the disaster scene is transmitted to the rescue workers through the miniature camera, thereby improving the rescue working efficiency.

title_en: Crushed material loading device
abstract_en: To provide a technique that enables recovery work, rescue activities, etc., in a place where it is difficult to perform the rescue activities and recovery work by manpower in a case of disaster such as a landslide, a building collapse, etc., caused by an earthquake or heavy rain.SOLUTION: A crushed material loading device has: a device body; three or more legs which are provided on the device body, and can change an attitude of the device body; a drilling device which drills a hole in a structure to be crushed; and a feed device which feeds crushed material as a non-explosive crushed composition into the hole formed in the structure by the drilling device. The at least three legs can be made extensible, and also changeable in angle to the device body so as to not only change the attitude of the device body, but also move the device body.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: UNIV AKITA;NIPPON KOKI KK;SANWA TEKKI CORP

title_en: Jack robot for disaster and control method of the same
title_ko: 재난용 잭 로봇 및 그것의 제어 방법
abstract_en: A jack robot for disaster, according to the present invention, comprises: a robot body made to move; a camera provided in the robot body to photograph the surroundings of the robot in real time; a controller provided in the robot body to input and output a control signal for the robot; a communication unit provided in the robot body, and for transmitting and receiving signals to and from a robot control device located outside and the camera and the controller to enable remote control; a jack mechanism provided on the robot body to lift an object while being operated according to a signal from the controller; and a jack push mechanism for moving the jack mechanism from a storage position in the robot body to a use position outside the robot body. The jack robot for disaster can secure an access road by lifting collapsed debris by being put in a place where people cannot enter, such as a collapsed building site, while monitoring the situation in real time by means of the mounted camera.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 재난용 잭 로봇은, 주행 가능하게 이루어진 로봇 바디와; 상기 로봇 바디에 구비되어 로봇 주변을 실시간으로 촬영하는 카메라와; 상기 로봇 바디에 구비되어 로봇에 대한 제어 신호를 입출력하는 제어부와; 상기 로봇 바디에 구비되어 외부에 위치되는 로봇 제어장치와 상기 카메라 및 제어부와 신호를 주고받도록 하여 원격 제어가 가능하도록 하는 통신부와; 상기 로봇 바디에 구비되어 상기 제어부의 신호에 따라 작동되면서 물체를 들어 올리는 잭 기구와; 상기 잭 기구를 상기 로봇 바디 내의 보관 위치에서 상기 로봇 바디 바깥쪽의 사용 위치로 이동시키는 잭 밀당기구를 포함하여 구성됨으로써 건물 붕괴 사고 현장 등에 사람이 들어가지 못하는 장소에 투입되어 무너진 잔해물을 들어 올려 진입로를 확보함과 동시에 장착된 카메라로 상황을 실시간으로 모니터링 할 수 있다.
assignees: KYUNGPOOK NAT UNIV IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND

title_en: High-rise building monitoring system with emergency evacuation guidance function
title_ko: 비상 대피 유도 기능을 갖는 고층 건물 잔불 감시 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비상 대피 유도 기능을 갖는 고층 건물 잔불 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로, 이를 위해 1차 소화 후 잔불을 감시하기 위해 건물의 각 화재층에 간이 설치되는 열화상카메라를 갖는 이동감지대;와, 상기 각 화재층에 설치된 이동감지대에 의해 감지된 정보를 근거리통신 및 원거리통신으로 연결받아 출력되는 전용단말기; 및 상기 각 이동감지대에 의해 잔불에 관한 정보를 원거리통신을 통해 제공받아 취합한 후, 이를 모니터링하고 더불어 전용단말기로 중계하는 중계서버;를 포함하여 이루어지되, 상기 전용단말기는 자체적으로 잔불 진압 현장의 건물의 붕괴 위험을 예측하고 소방대원에게 위험 경보를 발생시켜 비상 대피를 유도하는 대피모듈를 갖는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Earthquake rescue wood support design and assembly operation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake emergency rescue, in particular to an earthquake rescue wood support design and assembly operation system which comprises an applet end and a cloud service end, wherein the applet end comprises a building collapse scene data storage module, a wood support type selection module, a wood support size design module and a wood support system assembly module. The invention relates to an operable earthquake rescue wood support design assembly operation system, which realizes the calculation and assembly functions of the wood support. The invention effectively improves the rescue efficiency, enhances the rescue scientificity, improves the training level and enriches the teaching interest. The invention improves the receiving and understanding ability of students and the training effect of outdoor practical exercises in a sound earthquake rescue training teaching mode.

title_en: Mobile platform of miniature search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of building collapse ruin search and rescue equipment, in particular relates to a microminiature search and rescue robot moving platform which comprises two moving modules and a load module, wherein the two moving modules are connected end to form a snake-shaped robot moving platform, the two moving modules are identical in structure and comprise driving joints, deflection joints and a fixed shell, the driving joints provide power for the robot moving platform to walk, the deflection joints control the walking direction of the robot moving platform and ensure that the robot moving platform successfully avoids obstacles in the walking process, and the load module is internally provided with a life detector and a battery and can search and rescue in the ruins and provide a power supply for the wireless communication robot to realize functions. The mobile platform of the miniature snake-shaped robot has good adaptability under the complex environment inside the ruins of building collapse, is particularly suitable for passing through narrow gaps, and has the characteristics of modularized structure, light weight, flexible walking, easy installation, replacement and accurate control.

title_en: Device and method for avoiding building collapse through fire protection of building beams and stand columns
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and method for avoiding building collapse through fire protection of building beams and stand column. The method includes the steps that the outer walls of all concrete beams and stand columns for load-bearing or the outer walls of all stand columns made of metal of a building are provided with fire-resistant and heat preservation layers, and the fire-resistant and heat preservation layers are either metal shell fire-resistant and heat preservation layers or ceramic shell fire-resistant and heat preservation layers. By means of the device and method, the beams or the stand columns of the building can resist to big fire for a long time without collapse, and the tragedy that firefighters are buried in a dire scene is avoided. The device and method for avoiding building collapse through fire protection of building beams and stand columns are particularly suitable for being used for various buildings such as office buildings, residential buildings, schools, hospitals and research and development institutions.

title_en: floor indefendent type firefighting unit and floor indefendent type firefighting system using the same
title_ko: 건물 층별 소화유니트 및 이를 적용한 건물 층간 독립형 소방시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a floor independent type firefighting unit and a floor independent type firefighting system using the same. The floor independent type firefighting unit comprises: a pressurized tank which is independently arranged on the respective floor of a building and stores firefighting water in a pressurized state in a water storage space; a firefighting water supply unit which includes an opening and closing valve installed in a supply pipeline which is arranged in communication with the pressurized tank from a firefighting water spray nozzle arranged on the floor where the pressurized tank is installed, to open and close the supply pipeline according to a supply control signal; and a terminal control unit which controls the opening and closing valve to be opened when a fire detection signal is received from a fire detector installed on the floor where the firefighting water supply unit is installed so that the firefighting water stored in the pressurized tank is sprayed through the nozzle. The floor independent type firefighting unit and the floor independent type firefighting system using the same can perform fire detection and suppression independently on each floor, even when some floors collapse or the supply of commercial power is cut off due to the occurrence of a disaster situation such as an earthquake, thereby minimizing disaster damage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물 층별 소화유니트 및 이를 적용한 건물 층간 독립형 소방시스템에 관한 것으로서, 건물 층별 소화유니트는 건물의 해당 층에 독립되게 마련되며 소방수를 저수공간에 가압상태로 저장하는 가압탱크와, 가압탱크가 설치된 층에 마련된 소화수 분사용 노즐로부터 상기 가압탱크와 연통되게 마련된 공급관로에 설치되어 공급 제어신호에 따라 상기 공급관로를 개폐하는 개폐밸브가 마련된 소화수 공급부와, 소화수 공급부가 설치된 층에 장착된 화재감지기로부터 화재감지신호가 수신되면 개폐밸브가 개방되게 제어하여 가압탱크에 저수된 소화수가 노즐을 통해 분사되게 처리하는 단말제어부를 구비한다. 이러한 건물 층별 소화유니트 및 이를 적용한 건물 층간 독립형 소방시스템에 의하면, 지진과 같은 재난상황 발생에 의해 일부 층이 붕괴되거나 상용전원의 공급이 차단되더라도 층별로 자체 화재 감지 및 진화처리를 독립적으로 수행할 수 있어 재난 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Laminated elastomeric bearing having ability of safety check-up for bridge
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진 발생시의 교량 상판에 작용하는 변형을 감지하여 교량을 통과하는 차량과 원거리의 관리자에게 교량 상판의 변형을 알려주며, 교량 상판의 변형이 일정 범위를 벗어나는 경우 교량의 진입로를 차단하여 차량을 통제할 수 있는 교량 안전진단 기능을 갖는 교좌장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 의한 교량 안전진단 기능을 갖는 교좌장치는, 앵커볼트에 의해 교량 상판의 저부에 고정되는 상부패드와, 교각의 상면에 상기 상부패드와 대응되도록 앵커볼트에 의해 고정되는 하부패드와, 그 사이에 개재되는 완충패드로 구성되되, 상부패드의 저면에 부착되어 진동에 따른 기울기 각도를 감지하는 자이로스코프 센서로 된 제1감지기, 하부패드의 상면에 x축과 y축으로 각각 부착되어 축의 이동량을 감지하는 마이크로미터로 된 제2감지기, 및 상하부 패드의 일측면에 부착되어 상하 압축량을 감지하는 하이트 게이트로 된 제3감지기를 포함하여 이들 감지기의 감지신호를 실시간 모니터링하여 일정 변위를 벗어나는 교좌를 측정 확인 후 필요에 따라 교량을 통제하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Rescue signal transmission device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a rescue signal transmission device capable of increasing the possibility of rescue even if evacuation becomes difficult when a building collapses due to a disaster.SOLUTION: A rescue signal transmission device provided between an indoor ceiling and a fire alarm which is fixed to the ceiling and used comprises: an impact-resistance housing for protecting the inside of a device; an independent power supply arranged in the impact-resistance housing; building collapse detecting means driven by the independent power supply; and rescue signal transmitting means for transmitting a rescue signal by using the independent power supply when a building collapse is detected by the building collapse detecting means. The building collapse detecting means determines whether a building collapsed on the basis of acceleration information and information related to whether the fire alarm is electrically conducted.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A aftershock early warning device for earthquake rescue is on --spot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an aftershock early warning device for earthquake rescue is on - -spot, including supporting fixed part (1), aftershock early warning terminal (2) and vibration bracelet, the aftershock early warning electron device include: control circuit board, sensor, signal conditioning circuit, wireless communication equipment, alarm and power supply unit, the output of sensor passes through signal conditioning circuit is connected to control circuit board's input, control circuit board still respectively with the power supply unit with the alarm is connected, control circuit board passes through wireless communication equipment with the communication of vibration bracelet is connected. The advantage does: for a low -cost portable aftershock early warning device, have the quick detachable advantage of easy installation, very suitable rescue field usage can effectively reduce because strong aftershock causes the casualties that the house secondary collapses and bring.

title_en: Emergency rescue method and emergency rescue system for collapsed building
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency rescue method and an emergency rescue system for a collapsed building, and relates to the technical field of emergency rescue. The emergency rescue method for the collapsed building comprises the following steps: step one: before the building collapses, the detection unit predicts earthquake information in advance and gives out warning through the alarm unit, and on-site personnel make a response according to the emergency unit; step two: after the building collapses, the position of a person is detected through a rescue unit, the rescue is excavated, and medical care is timely ensured; step three: temporary dwellings are built outdoors through the building units, rescue channels are provided, and ground cushion pads are paved to cope with secondary earthquakes. According to different earthquake grades, the emergency unit can flexibly select equipment such as an emergency channel, an emergency protection box, an anti-explosion self-rescue bag and the like, so that on-site personnel can make optimal selection according to the environment where the emergency unit is located, and each module of the emergency rescue system cooperatively works, thereby ensuring efficient and orderly rescue process.

title_en: Collapse monitoring and early warning system in building fire and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collapse monitoring and early warning system in building fire and an implementation method thereof. The building collapse early warning system carries out data acquisition modeling on the building, installs the deformation monitoring device at key positions in the building, gives an alarm after the preset value is exceeded, carries out comparison, analysis and processing on the acquired data and the standard data, thereby accurately early warning the collapse of the building, and transmits the early warning data to rescuers, so that the rescuers can deal with the early warning in time, the potential safety hazard of the rescuers is reduced, and the building collapse early warning system has popularization and application values.

title_en: Exploration robot for dangerous spot search
title_ko: 건물 및 토목시설 붕괴지역 탐사 대응 로봇
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 재난지역 탐사 대응 로봇은, 입력신호에 따라 정/역회전이 가능한 하나 이상의 구동모터(100); 상기 구동모터(100)와 연결되어 동력을 전달하는 기어모듈(110); 상기 기어모듈(110)과 결합되어 회전하는 2쌍이상의 구동 바퀴(120);를 포함하는 구동부(1000); 주행 방향과 일치하는 촬영 방향을 갖고 주행 방향의 영상을 획득하는 메인 카메라(200); 초음파를 이용하여 주변 장애물과의 거리 측정값 데이터를 생성하는 초음파센서(300); 외부로 데이터를 송신하거나, 제어신호를 수신하는 송수신장치(400); 상기 구동모터(100), 메인 카메라(200), 초음파센서(300) 및 송수신장치(400)와 연결되고, 송수신장치(400)에서 수신되는 제어신호에 따른 구동모터(100)의 제어 및 메인 카메라(200), 초음파센서(300)에서 획득하는 데이터를 상기 송수신장치(400)로 전송하는 제어보드(500); 상기 제어보드(500)와 연결되어, 제어신호 및 메인 카메라(200), 초음파센서(300)에서 획득하는 데이터를 저장하는 메인 메모리(600); 상기 각 구성요소와 연결되어 전력을 공급하는 배터리(700);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System searching of sufferer based on unmanned aerial vehicle
title_ko: 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템에 관한 것으로, 무인 비행하는 드론에 음향 센서를 부착하여, 화재현장이나 붕괴현장과 같은 각종 재해현장에서 접근이 어려운 환경 조건에서도 조난자로부터 발생하는 특정 주파수 대역의 음향만을 탐지하여 조난자가 발생한 것으로 판단할 수 있는 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템을 제공하는 것이다.

title_en: Intelligent fire monitoring and automatic fire extinguishing method and system in highway steel structure canopy
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire monitoring and automatic fire extinguishing method and system in a highway steel structure canopy, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource perception data of a fire scene through a double-spectrum imaging device, wherein the multisource perception data comprises video streams and a temperature distribution matrix; the fire source position, the heat release rate, the wind field condition and the structure configuration are input into a fire evolution prediction model, the fire expansion path and the heat intensity change are dynamically simulated, the heat release intensity and the high-temperature spreading trend of the fire source are calculated by combining a temperature distribution matrix, the comprehensive priority ranking result is calculated according to the heat release intensity, the structural damage degree, the personnel distribution and the material value of the fire source, the fire extinguishing and rescue task scheduling strategy is generated, and the fire extinguishing and rescue are performed.
assignees: SHENZHONG CHANNEL MAN CENTER;GUANGZHOU KAIBO BRIDGE ENG CO LTD;BOSHEN BRANCH GUANGDONG BODA EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;HUANGPU BRIDGE OF PEARL RIVER IN GUANGZHOU

title_en: Smart wearable device for disaster response and disaster response system using thereof
title_ko: 재난대응을 위한 스마트 웨어러블장치 및 이를 이용한 재난대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and a method for a swift and safe response when a disaster occurs. According to the present invention, a wearable device which can be worn or attached to the body of a user, to help the user swiftly and safely evacuate in case of natural disasters including typhoon, flood, storm, and earthquake, as well as other accidents such as fire, collapsing building, explosion, forest fire, and shipwrecking, is provided. The smart wearable device is capable of instructing a safe evacuation route based on the current location of the user. Thus, the user is provided with a safe route without the presence of additional equipment or tools during a disaster. Also, according to the present invention, provided is a system for preemptively and efficiently responding to disasters at the early stage to minimize casualties and property damage through a network of wireless sensors which sense the smart wearable device and various sensors, at the same time helping people in danger to swiftly and safely evacuate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난발생시 신속하고 안전한 대응을 위한 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따르면, 예를 들면, 태풍, 홍수, 폭풍, 지진 등과 같은 자연재해나, 건물화재, 붕괴, 폭발, 산불, 선박침몰 등과 같은 각종 재난상황 발생시 조난자를 신속하고 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있도록 하기 위해, 사용자의 몸에 착용 가능한 웨어러블 디바이스(wearable device)의 형태로 구성되어 현재위치를 기준으로 안전한 대피 경로를 제공할 수 있도록 구성됨으로써, 재난상황 발생시 별도의 장비나 도구를 휴대할 필요 없이 안전한 대피 경로를 제공할 수 있도록 구성되는 재난대응을 위한 스마트 웨어러블장치가 제공되며, 또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 상기한 바와 같이 재난상황 발생시 안전한 대피 경로를 제공하기 위해 사용자의 몸에 착용 가능한 웨어러블 디바이스의 형태로 구성되는 재난대응을 위한 스마트 웨어러블장치 및 다양한 센서들을 활용하여 각종 재난상황을 감지하는 무선 센서 네트워크의 연동을 통하여, 각종 재난상황 발생시 조난자를 신속하고 안전하게 대피시키는 동시에, 재난발생 초기에 선제적이고 효율적인 재난대응이 가능하여 인명 및 재산피해를 최소화할 수 있도록 구성되는 재난대응 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Rail embankment disease emergency rescue reinforcement structure and reinforcement method
abstract_en: The application discloses a railway embankment disease emergency rescue reinforcement structure and a reinforcement method, which belong to the technical field of roadbed retaining protection, and are used for forming a reinforcement structure on a retaining structure on one side of an embankment slope, wherein the reinforcement structure comprises a support panel attached to one side of an inclined plane of the retaining structure and a support structure arranged at intervals with the support panel, and the support structure penetrates into a ground plane along a vertical part to fix the support structure; and still be equipped with the backup pad between support panel and the bearing structure, this backup pad one end butt support panel's inclined plane, its other end and bearing structure butt to support the panel tightly on the inclined plane of retaining structure. According to the application, the support panel and the support structure are arranged on the basis of not damaging the original support structure, so that the stable use of the support structure can be ensured by the existing reinforcement structure, the problems of long construction period and secondary collapse in the construction process caused by damaging the support structure are avoided, and the safety and timeliness of the repair treatment of the support structure are greatly improved.

title_en: Bridge rescue training facility and training method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge rescue training facility and a method, wherein the bridge rescue training facility is provided with a bridge area and a bridge lower area, a plurality of engineering elevators and a plurality of stairways are arranged on the side face of the bridge area, the engineering elevators are used for assisting in carrying appliances to a bridge deck, the bridge rescue training facility is provided with structural stress monitoring sensors at structural stress points, the structural stress monitoring sensors are used for monitoring structural stability in real time, when a structural member is damaged or reaches a maximum set stress value, the bridge area is provided with a bridge intact section, a bridge damaged section and a traffic accident occurring section, the bridge lower area is provided with a dangerous chemical tank car accident occurring section, the bridge damaged section is provided with a bridge damaged point and a bridge damaged section, the bridge upper structural damage, the lower structural damage, the foundation damage and the bridge broken scene are simulated after an earthquake disaster, the bridge is rapidly broken, the bridge is robbed, and the bridge damage points are positioned on a bridge deck, a drop-proof baffle, a supporting seat, a pier and the foundation position.

title_en: Real-time Personnel Identification System
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a system for counting the number of people in real time capable of preventing inefficient manpower input for rescuing buried people and quickly progressing a lifesaving activity by collecting data on how many people are in each area in real time until a building collapses through a human body sensing unit to transmit the collected data to a data processing unit, updating collected data in real time through a data control unit and then transmitting updated data to a web server, and transmitting the updated data to certified users including rescue workers and rescue teams through the web browser when a building collapses due to unexpected accidents such as earthquake or natural disasters.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지진과 같은 자연재해나 예기치 못 한 사고로 인해 건물이 붕괴할 경우 건물이 무너지기까지 실시간으로 각 구역 내의 몇 명의 사람이 있는지에 대한 데이터를 인체 감지부를 통해 수집하여 데이터 처리부에 전송하고, 데이터 제어부를 통해 상기 데이터를 실시간으로 업데이트 후 웹 서버에 전송하고, 웹 서버는 웹 브라우저를 통해 구조대원 및 구조대를 포함한 인증된 사용자에게 전달함으로 써 매몰된 인명을 구조하는 데 있어 비효율적인 인력 투입을 방지할 수 있으며 보다 신속하게 인명구조 활동을 진행할 수 있게 만드는 효과를 가진 실시간 인원 파악 시스템을 제공하는데 목적이 있다.
