title_en: Radar sensor-based bio-inspired autonomous mobile robot using BLE location tracking for disaster rescue
abstract_en: An autonomous bio-inspired mobile robotic device ( 200 ) capable of detecting, tracking and communicating location of survivor(s) ( 34 ) trapped under earthquake/building collapse debris ( 30, 32 ). The small-size, lightweight, ruggedized autonomous legged mobile robot ( 200 ) incorporates high-frequency millimeter-wave radar sensor ( 10 ) and Ultra Wideband (IR-UWB) radar sensor ( 12 ) for detecting presence and perform ranging of trapped survivor(s) ( 34 ). The autonomous mobile robot ( 200 ) also comprises GNSS ( 8 ) and BLE ( 4 ) connectivity for location tracking of trapped survivor(s) ( 34 ) in conjunction with a Wi-Fi enabled visual sensing solution ( 20 ) and a flashlight ( 16 ) to aid during rescue operation. The battery-powered ( 24 ) autonomous bio-inspired mobile robot ( 200 ) also comprises an MCU ( 26 ), actuators ( 14   b ), motor control circuitry ( 18 ) and IMU ( 6 ) to control robot ( 200 ) locomotion and perform sensor data fusion. BLE ( 4 ) connectivity solution of the present invention ( 200 ) communicates the location of detected trapped survivor(s) ( 34 ) to a plurality of rescue devices ( 44 A,  44 B,  44 C) using Angle-of-Arrival ( 700 )/Angle-of-Departure ( 800 ) method for successful survivor ( 34 ) location resolution.

title_en: Emergency rescue apparatus for building collapse
abstract_en: An emergency rescue apparatus for building collapse. The emergency rescue apparatus comprises a suction and digging robot (3), a gas-solid separation device (2) and a power device (1), wherein the power device (1) is connected to the gas-solid separation device (2) by means of a pipeline, and the gas-solid separation device (2) is connected to the suction and digging robot (3) by means of a pipeline; the power device (1) is used for providing hydraulic power for the gas-solid separation device (2) and the suction and digging robot (3); the power device (1) is further used for providing negative-pressure suction power for the gas-solid separation device (2) and the suction and digging robot (3); the suction and digging robot (3) is used for sucking and digging through a collapsed building; the gas-solid separation device (2) is used for storing collapsed building material sucked and dug through by the suction and digging robot (3); and the gas-solid separation device (2) is further used for purifying gas in the gas-solid separation device (2).
assignees: FUJIAN QIAOLONG EMERGENCY EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Remote Controllable fire fighting truck
abstract_ko:
본 개시는 사전 제작된 대형 소방차에 탑재하여 이동성과 기동성을 갖되 자체 동력으로 주행이 가능하여 화재 진압에 대한 유리한 위치 선정 및 접근성이 우수하고, 화재의 초기 진압성이 우수하여 인명을 보호하고, 재산피해를 최대한으로 억제가 가능하며, 소방호스가 탑재되어 있어 대형 소방차로부터 무거운 소방호스를 현장까지 운반해야되는 기존의 소방호스 제공방법이 개선되고, 이를 통해 소방전 등과 연결이 용이하여 화재 및 주변환경에 대한 적극적인 대처가 가능해져 화재 진압의 유리함이 제공되고, 골목길 등의 좁은 통행로의 각종 장애물을 피해 무거운 소방호스를 화재현장까지 운반이 가능하여 시간 소비의 낭비가 발생되지 않아 초기 진압이 유리하며, 원격 컨트롤에 따른 무인 이동이 가능하여 화재 현장에 투입된 소방관이 화염과 연소에 의한 유독가스 및 건물 붕괴, 고온의 화염이 발생하고 폭발 등의 위험을 받는 종래 문제점이 해결되고, 계단이나 건물 붕괴 등으로 인한 잔해에 따른 장애물 통과에 대한 극복이 유리하고, 좁은 공간이나 사람이 출입할 수 없는 곳에 접근이 유리해 효과적인 화재 진압이 가능하며, 화재 진압을 위한 복합적인 기술과 기능의 접목으로 인해 효과적인 화재 진압이 가능하고, 화재 현장에서의 소방 활동성이 보장되어 소방로봇 개발과 보급에 대한 발판이 되고, 화재현장으로 소방호스를 이동해 화재 진압을 함으로써 고압대 유량의 방수가 어려운 종래의 문제점이 개선되는 장점을 갖는 원격 컨트롤이 가능한 방수포에 관한 것이다. 
본 개시의 실시예에 따른 원격 컨트롤이 가능한 방수포는 소방호스가 적재되며, 기제작된 소방차에 상하차되는 몸체와, 상기 몸체의 하부에 결합되되, 계단 또는 건물 붕괴 등으로 인한 장애물을 통과하여 상기 몸체가 화재 진압을 위한 장소로 위치 이동되도록 주행시키는 궤도바퀴 및 상기 몸체의 전방측에 설치되되, 소방차 또는 소화전 등으로부터 공급되는 소방수를 화재 지점에 고압으로 분사하는 방수포를 포함하고, 상기 몸체와 상기 궤도바퀴 및 상기 방수포는 원격에 의한 무인으로 작동된다.

title_en: Bridge rescue training facility and training method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge rescue training facility and a method, wherein the bridge rescue training facility is provided with a bridge area and a bridge lower area, a plurality of engineering elevators and a plurality of stairways are arranged on the side face of the bridge area, the engineering elevators are used for assisting in carrying appliances to a bridge deck, the bridge rescue training facility is provided with structural stress monitoring sensors at structural stress points, the structural stress monitoring sensors are used for monitoring structural stability in real time, when a structural member is damaged or reaches a maximum set stress value, the bridge area is provided with a bridge intact section, a bridge damaged section and a traffic accident occurring section, the bridge lower area is provided with a dangerous chemical tank car accident occurring section, the bridge damaged section is provided with a bridge damaged point and a bridge damaged section, the bridge upper structural damage, the lower structural damage, the foundation damage and the bridge broken scene are simulated after an earthquake disaster, the bridge is rapidly broken, the bridge is robbed, and the bridge damage points are positioned on a bridge deck, a drop-proof baffle, a supporting seat, a pier and the foundation position.

title_en: Hollow snake robot for topographical detection of a urial and collapse and control method thereof
title_ko: 붕괴지형 매몰자 탐지를 위한 뱀 로봇 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a hollow snake robot for detecting a buried person in a flat and narrow space, and a control method thereof. According to an aspect of the present invention, the hollow snake robot comprises: a hollow body unit constructed by connecting a plurality of modules having drive shafts perpendicular to each other in a universal joint scheme; a supply unit connected to one end of the body unit; and a robot hand which is connected to at least a portion of the supply unit, and performs a task by gripping or liberating an object. The supply unit includes: a tube inserted into the hollow space of the other end of the body unit to move a first material associated with survival of a rescue request person to the outside through the one end; a camera to photograph an area around the hollow snake robot; a temperature sensor to measure the temperature of the area around the hollow snake robot; a gas sensor to measure a gas amount and the present of gas in the area around the hollow snake robot; a microphone to receive a voice of the rescue request person and a sound in the area around the hollow snake robot; a speaker to output information inputted from the outside; and a projector to use light to output an image to the area around the hollow snake robot. The hollow snake robot may further comprise a communication unit to transfer information acquired through at least one among the camera, the temperature sensor, the gas sensor, and the microphone to the outside via wired communication or wireless communication.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 양상인 중공형 뱀 로봇은, 유니버설 조인트(universal joint) 방식의 서로 직교하는 구동축을 가진 복수의 모듈을 연결하여 구성된 중공형의 몸통부; 상기 몸통부의 일단에 연결되는 공급부; 및 상기 공급부의 적어도 일부에 연결되고, 객체를 파지 또는 해방하여 태스크(task)를 수행하는 로봇 핸드; 를 포함하고, 상기 공급부는, 상기 몸통부의 타단의 중공으로 삽입되고, 상기 일단을 통해 외부로 구조요청자의 생존과 관련된 제 1 물질을 이동시키기 위한 튜브; 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역을 촬영하는 카메라; 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역의 온도를 측정하는 온도 센서; 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역의 가스 유무 및 가스량을 측정하는 가스 센서; 상기 구조요청자의 음성 및 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역의 소리를 입력 받는 마이크로폰; 상기 외부로부터 입력된 정보를 출력하기 위한 스피커; 및 빛을 이용하여 영상을 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역으로 출력하는 프로젝터;를 더 포함하며, 상기 카메라, 온도 센서, 가스 센서 및 마이크로폰 중 적어도 하나를 통해 획득한 정보를, 유선 통신 또는 무선 통신을 통해 외부로 전달하기 위한 통신부;를 더 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Radar sensor-based bio-inspired autonomous mobile robot using ble location tracking for disaster rescue
abstract_en: An autonomous bio-inspired mobile robotic device (100) capable of detecting, tracking and communicating location of survivors trapped under earthquake/building collapse debris. The small-size, lightweight, ruggedized autonomous legged mobile robot incorporates high-frequency millimeter-wave radar sensor and Ultra Wideband (IR-UWB) radar sensor for detecting presence and perform ranging of trapped survivors. The autonomous mobile robot also comprises GNSS and BLE connectivity for location tracking of trapped survivors in conjunction with a Wi-Fi enabled visual sensing solution and a flashlight to aid during rescue operation. The battery-powered autonomous bio-inspired mobile robot (100) also comprises an MCU, actuators, motor control circuitry and IMU to control robot locomotion and perform sensor data fusion. BLE connectivity solution of the present invention communicates the location of detected trapped survivors to a plurality of rescue devices which use BLE Angle-of-Arrival method for successful survivor location resolution.

title_en: Operation method for gas detetction robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gas detection robot operation method capable of enabling an emergency response and minimizing the loss of lives in a terror and disaster site, which is difficult for people to access, such as a fire, a harmful gas leak, a collapse, an explosion risk or the like. Moreover, in accordance with the present invention, the gas detection robot operation method includes: an overall search step of measuring gas in a predetermined area for a predetermined time through a gas detection robot, and comparing d_t, which is a concentration value of the measured gas, and d_t-1, which is a gas concentration value measured for the predetermined time before the d_t measurement in the predetermined area, with each other; and a termination step of terminating the overall search step when the value of the d_t-1 is greater than the d_t in the overall search step.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재, 유해가스 누출, 붕괴 및 폭발 위험 등 사람이 접근하기 어려운 테러 및 재난현장에서 긴급 대응이 가능하고 인명 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 기체 탐지 로봇의 운용 방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한, 본 발명은 기체 탐지 로봇을 사용하여 소정의 시간 동안 소정의 영역에서 기체를 측정하고, 측정된 기체의 농도 값인 d t 와 상기 소정의 영역에서 상기 d t  측정 이전에 상기 소정의 시간동안 측정된 기체 농도 값인 d t-1 을 서로 비교하는 전체적 탐색 단계 및 상기 전체적 탐색 단계에서 상기 d t 보다 상기 d t-1 의 값이 크면 상기 전체적 탐색 단계를 종료하는 종료 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Clamping shearing snatching and seam expanding integral rescue tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a clamping shearing snatching and seam expanding integral rescue tool, which comprises a clamping shearing holding snatching and seam expanding conversion device, a constant shearing force device, holding and snatching mechanisms of four pairs of four-connecting-rod mechanisms and a seam expanding device, wherein a deformation hydraulic cylinder of the clamping shearing holding snatching and seam expanding form conversion device and a slide block  realize the mutual switching among the clamping shearing, holding snatching and seam expanding forms; the constant shearing force device provides uniform shearing force for the clamping and shearing process; the secondary collapse in the rescue process is prevented; a holding snatching hydraulic cylinder of the four-connecting-rod holding snatching mechanism controls the position of holding snatching claws to realize the shielding and the work of clamp shear blades, and is matched with the clamping shearing holding snatching and seam expanding conversion device to complete the holding and snatching operation. The four functions including the clamping, shearing, holding snatching and seam expanding are integrated into one tool; the structure is reasonable and creative; the operation is simple and convenient; the dealing with complicated rescue environment can be realized; the complicated residue operation can be fast completed; the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_ko: 아메바 운동을 응용한 인명 구조용 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a robot to save a life applied with amoebic movement which enables a rescue worker to more quickly grasp a position of a survivor in a buried space, thus enabling fast rescuing to save a human life. Moreover, a machine entering an inside of a collapsed structure photographs a surrounding environment using a camera, and photographed information is received from the outside to quickly grasp the position of the survivor. In addition, various relief supplies are transmitted to the survivor for the survivor not to pass away before a rescue team enters. According to the present invention, a robot to save the life applied with amoebic movement comprises: an inner layer; an outer layer; filling materials; a plurality of small electromagnets; and a driving controller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 아메바 운동을 응용한 인명 구조 로봇의 발명에 관한 것으로 구조요원으로 하여금 매몰된 공간에서의 생존자의 위치 파악을 더욱 신속하게 할 수 있게 하여 빠른 구조가 가능해 사람의 생명을 구하는데에 목적이 있으며 붕괴된 구조물 내부로 진입한 기계가 카메라를 이용해 주변 환경을 촬영하고 촬영한 정보를 외부로 수신하여 생존자의 위치를 빠르게 파악하는 것뿐만 아니라 생존자에게 각종 구호물자를 전달하여 구조대가 진입하기 전까지 생존자를 사망에 이르지 않도록 한다.

title_en: Drive system of life structure elevator of skyscraper
abstract_en: Provided is a life-saving elevator drive system for a high-rise building using a wire horizontal turning unit, which vertically and horizontally moves an elevator along an outer wall of the high-rise building for rescuing human life. The drive system includes a guide rail(200) having a wire horizontal turning unit(100) operating a turning operation of a wire of a constant length on the roof of a high-rise building in a horizontal direction, an elevator drive unit(300) moving according to the turning operation of the guide rail and wire and having a pair of elevator lifting guide wires(400) which are installed on the elevator drive unit in a lower direction, and an elevator(500) having a wire lifting drive unit for moving the wire in a desired position of an outer wall of the high-rise building for rescuing human life.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 고층건물에 화재나 지진, 건물붕괴 등과 같은 긴급 상황이 발생할 경우 건물의 외벽을 따라 신속하게 승강이동하여 안전하게 인명을 구조하여 재난으로 부터 인명피해의 최소화를 도모하는데 크게 일조할 수 있는 새로운 형태의 초고층 건물의 인명구조용 엘리베이터 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     	즉, 고층건물 옥상의 일측에 일정한 길이의 와이어를 좌우방향으로 선회 작동할 수 있는 와이어 좌우 선회장치와; 그 일측에 일정한 길이의 가이드레일과; 상기 가이드레일과 선회장치 와이어의 선회작동에 따라 좌우 일정간격 이동이 자유롭고 엘리베이터의 리프팅 매개체인 상하 리프팅 안내용 와이어가 권설된 엘리베이터 구동장치와; 상기 엘리베이터 구동장치에 권설된 상태에서 건물의 하방 지면으로 두 가닥 늘어뜨려져 엘리베이터의 리프팅 매개로 작용하는 엘리베이터 상, 하 리프팅 안내용 와이어와; 상기 건물바닥으로 하향 늘어뜨려진 두 줄의 상, 하 리프팅 안내용 와이어에 선택 장착된 상태에서 그 와이어를 타고 스스로 리프팅 구동하면서 필요한 건물 외벽위치로 이동하여 인명 구조할 수 있도록 하는 와이어리프팅 구동장치를 가진 구조용 엘리베이터; 를 포함하여 이루어지는 것이다. 
       
     	와이어, 구동모터, 가이드레일, 엘리베이터, 끼움홈, 보조커버, 힌지핀
assignees: JIN YOUNG R & S CO LTD

title_en: The group escape safety chuter on the double brakes pulley type for the fire refuge
title_ko: 화재대피용 이중브레이크 도르래타입 다인승 완강 안전장치
abstract_en: A group escape safety chute in a double brake pulley type for fire escape is provided to enable several people to escape at an emergency safely and to minimize damage of humans. A rope(78) is wound on a pulley body which has a brake function by a brake gear and is rotated by a pulley gear(52) to form a group escape safety chute in a double brake pulley type for fire escape. A pulley gear body(50) is installed to be adjacent to a pulley body for a descending rope. A first brake body is received into a body brake chamber(82) and a second brake body is received into a cover brake chamber(92) to make brake iron cores do the function of brakes well by the friction with each brake chamber. Two brake bodies are arranged on both sides of a brake pulley body.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지금까지 개발된 완강 장치가 모두 1인용이란 것인데 반하여 본 발명이 추구하는 목적은 어린이를 포함하여 나약한 이들에게 홀로 로프를 잡고 내려가라고 한다면 아예 던져버리는 것과 같다는 점에서 힘 있는 이와 함께 내려갈 수 있는 완강 장치의 개발이 필연적이라는 점에서 발명을 하게 된 것이다. 
     이러한 필연성에 의거하여 개발된 것으로 일명 다인용 완강 장치라고 명명하면서 이를 감당할 수 있도록 강화할 부분이 무게로 인한 가속도를 적절하게 잡아줄 수 있는 브레이크를 추가한다는 것이고 이에 합당하도록 몸체와 덮개에 각각 브레이크 집을 만들어 브레이크를 장착하면서 이 가운데에 하강을 위한 로프의 회전용 롤러와 같이 돌려질 치차와 맞물리는 작은 치차의 속도를 앞과 뒤에서 잡아주므로 인한 완만한 하강을 유도시키는 장치의 개발이다. 
     이 다인용 완강 장치로 인하여 심약한 이들과 함께 대피할 수 있게 되어 붕괴 도는 화재 등의 재난에서 높은 층 또는 절벽 등지로부터 심약한 이들과 함께 내려오므로 대피의 효율성을 높여 주는 효과를 얻게 될 것이다. 
       
     완만한 하강장치(緩慢한 下降裝置),   이중브레이크(Duplex Brake),   도르래(Pulley),   활강(Chute),   소방용구,   탈출슈트(escape chute),

title_en: Apparatus of emergency lamp for disaster rescue
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster relief emergency light device. The device comprises: a differential GPS unit receiving a signal of a GPS satellite to extract precise coordinate information; a disaster relief control unit recording and managing user personal information; an LED lighting unit selectively lighting on or off an LED in white or red; a solar generation unit outputting power generated by sunlight radiation to a 5.1 voltage of constant voltage or constant current or interrupting the power; a commercial electricity unit outputting the 5.1 voltage of constant voltage to the constant current or interrupting the constant voltage; an emergency charge and discharge unit charged by inputting the 5.1 voltage of constant voltage to the constant current; and an anion generation unit generating and emitting an anion when analyzing surrounding air and it is detected that harmful gas is included. Accordingly, the present invention has an effect of protecting breathing of a sufferer.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 정전, 화재, 지진, 태풍, 홍수, 붕괴 등이 포함되는 각종 재난이 발생한 지역에 위치하는 경우 생존자의 위치정보를 정말한 좌표정보로 외부에 알려주고 어두운 장소에서 조난자에게 주변을 확인하도록 조명하여 안정감을 주며, 과다한 먼지 또는 유해가스 등으로부터 조난자의 안전한 호흡을 위하여 정화된 공기를 제공하는 재난 구조 비상등 장치에 관한 것으로 지피에스 인공위성의 신호를 수신하여 50 센티미터 이내의 오차범위에 의한 정밀좌표정보를 추출하는 정밀지피에스부; 정밀지피에스부에 접속하여 현재 위치의 정밀좌표정보를 입력받고 재난 구조 비상등 장치의 전체 운용을 감시하며 각 구성부에 해당 제어신호를 각각 출력하고 각 구성부 사이의 해당 신호 전송경로를 스위칭하며 사용자 신상정보를 기록 관리하는 재난구조제어부; 재난구조제어부의 해당 제어신호에 의하여 6 개 이상의 다수로 이루어지는 5 와트급 엘이디를 선택적으로 백색 또는 적색으로 점등 또는 점멸시키는 엘이디조명부; 재난구조제어부에 접속하고 해당 제어신호를 입력하며 태양광 조사에 의하여 발전된 전력을 5.1 볼트의 정전압과 정정류로 출력하거나 차단하는 태양광발전부; 재난구조제어부에 접속하고 해당 제어신호에 의하여 상용전원을 입력하고 5.1 볼트의 정전압을 정정류로 출력하거나 차단하는 상용전원부; 재난구조제어부에 접속하고 해당 제어신호에 의하여 태양광발전부 또는 상용전원부로부터 인가되는 5.1 볼트의 정전압을 정정류로 입력하여 충전하는 비상충방전부; 재난구조제어부에 접속하고 해당 제어신호에 의하여 주변 공기를 분석하여 유해가스가 포함된 것으로 검출되면 음이온을 발생하여 배출하는 음이온발생부를 포함하는 특징에 의하여 상용전원이 공급되지 않는 경우에도 충방전배터리를 충전시키고 재난발생 상황을 국제공용 조난구조신호로 출력하면서 사이렌, SOS와 다수 통신경로를 이용하여 구조요청 신호를 송출하므로 재난상황을 주변에 정확하고 빠르게 전달하며, 조난자의 호흡을 보호하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method for extinguishing fire by using flue gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extinguishing fire by using flue gas, which comprises the following steps of: 1, collecting the stored flue gas: compressing the flue gas exhausted to a chimney by a boiler into a mobile gas storage tank or a fixed gas storage tank by using an air compressor, wherein the output end of the fixed gas storage tank is communicated with a gas pipeline of a user side through a building gas pipe network; 2, collocating an air respirator for emergency escape of a wearer indoors; 3, inflating gas to the room to extinguish fire: when a fire disaster happens, automatically opening a pipeline valve communicated with the fixed gas storage tank indoors by a trapped person to inflate the gas to the room to extinguish fire; supplying the flue gas to the fixed gas storage tank in time by a rescuer, or closing the pipeline valve at the output end in time according to the fire extinguishing condition; and 4, performing safe escape, namely the trapped person wears the air respirator and escapes the danger zone per se. By using the flue gas to extinguish the fire, the fire is extinguished quickly, the effect is good, articles are not damaged, building collapse accidents and personnel burn can be prevented, fire spread is effectively controlled, the escape time for trapped persons is prolonged, and the method has unique advantages of fire extinguishment of high-rise buildings.

title_en: Protective tool for auxiliary operation and rescue in collapse risk environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protective tool for auxiliary operation and rescue in an environment with collapse risk, which belongs to the technical field of rescue protection and comprises a head assembly, a chest assembly and an external display assembly. According to the invention, collapse impact force can be effectively absorbed, the risk of craniocerebral injury is reduced, the face is prevented from being scratched by crushed objects through the protective mask, the relative breathing space can be formed, air required by breathing is provided, the transverse and longitudinal distance of the position of the buried person and the general posture of the human body when the buried person is buried can be obtained, references are provided for external rescue personnel to command large-scale machinery to participate in rescue and rescue by using tools, the rescue time is shortened, and the rescue mask can be used for talking with the trapped person in the rescue process, so that psychological comfort is carried out on the trapped person.

title_en: Heterogeneous equipment path planning method under complex collapse scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a heterogeneous equipment path planning method under a complex collapse scene, and belongs to the field of emergency rescue heterogeneous equipment navigation and path planning. Setting a terrain index threshold and an initial voxel resolution by utilizing complex collapse scene environment information and heterogeneous equipment characteristics acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle, constructing a three-dimensional voxel map with dynamic resolution by taking octree as a frame, realizing balance of terrain details and storage efficiency, calculating basic terrain indexes and collapse catastrophe indexes, completing traversal risk assessment and passable area division, and adopting improved technology And (3) an algorithm, which fuses the terrain risk and the path smoothness requirement, and generates an optimal path for adapting to heterogeneous equipment. The method can effectively improve the safety and the high efficiency of equipment path planning in complex collapse scenes, is suitable for emergency rescue scenes such as earthquake, building collapse and the like, and provides reliable path support for heterogeneous equipment rescue operation.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;CHINA ACADEMY SAFETY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Polarization SAR data identification collapse construction method based on Fourier transform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying collapsed building by polarized SAR data based on Fourier transform, which provides a new characteristic parameter, namely an angular domain variation coefficient CV_AFI based on Fourier transform amplitude spectrum, which is used for identifying the collapsed building and a perfect inclined building, and extracting the collapsed building of a post-earthquake disaster area by combining a polarization decomposition method. The method provided by the invention has the advantages that the identification precision of damaged buildings can reach 82.95 percent, and the identification precision of intact buildings can reach 85.20 percent. 78% of the perfectly inclined buildings were successfully separated from the collapsed buildings. If the perfect buildings are mistakenly recognized as collapsed buildings, misleading rescue deployment is conducted, and a large amount of disaster relief resources are consumed. The CV_AFI parameter provided by the invention can effectively describe the space distribution difference and the structural characteristic difference of the collapsed building and the inclined building in the frequency domain, can better identify the two buildings, and improves the accuracy of identifying earthquake damage of the building after earthquake.

title_en: Underground facility survey system for measuring depth of underground facility using level staff
title_ko: 수준 표척을 이용하여 지하시설물의 심도를 측정할수 있는 지하시설물 측량시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground facility surveying system and, more specifically, to an underground facility surveying system capable of measuring the depth of an underground facility by using a level indicator. The underground facility surveying system comprises: a lower level indicator which can be inserted into an excavation hole and has a scale engraved on the front surface thereof; an upper level indicator which is inserted into the lower level indicator, can be adjusted in length in a sliding and elastic manner, and has a scale engraved on the front surface thereof; a rotary buffer landing means which is provided at the lower end of the lower level indicator; a vertical maintaining means which is coupled to the upper end of the lower level indicator and allows the lower level indicator and the upper level indicator to be vertical; a foldable handle which is foldably connected to the upper end of the lower level indicator; and a level device which is installed adjacent to the outside of the excavation hole and can measure the scale engraved on the lower level indicator and the upper level indicator. The underground facility surveying system can prevent casualties caused by earth and sand collapse or fall by allowing a level indicator to stand at a desired point without entering the excavation hole.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하시설물 측량시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 굴착공 안으로 진입시킬 수 있으며 전면에 눈금이 새겨진 하부표척, 하부표척에 삽입되어 슬라이드 신축식으로 길이 조절이 가능하며 전면에 눈금이 새겨진 상부표척, 하부표척의 하단에 구비되는 회전식 완충착지수단, 하부표척의 상단에 결합되어 하부표척과 상부표척이 수직을 이루도록 하는 수직유지수단, 하부표척의 상단에 접이식으로 연결되는 접이식 핸들 및 굴착공의 바깥에 인접 설치되어 하부표척과 상부표척에 새겨진 눈금을 측정할 수 있는 레벨장치를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하여, 표척수가 굴착공 내로 들어가지 않고서 표척을 원하는 지점에 세울 수 있어 토사붕괴 또는 추락 등에 의한 인명사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있는 수준 표척을 이용하여 지하시설물의 심도를 측정할 수 있는 지하시설물 측량시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System searching of sufferer based on unmanned aerial vehicle
title_ko: 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unmanned flight-based victim search system. The present invention is to provide an unmanned flight-based victim search system which attaches a sound sensor to an unmanned flying drone to detect only a sound of a specific frequency band generated from a victim even in environmental conditions difficult to access at various disaster sites such as fire sites or collapse sites, thereby determining that the victim has occurred.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템에 관한 것으로, 무인 비행하는 드론에 음향 센서를 부착하여, 화재현장이나 붕괴현장과 같은 각종 재해현장에서 접근이 어려운 환경 조건에서도 조난자로부터 발생하는 특정 주파수 대역의 음향만을 탐지하여 조난자가 발생한 것으로 판단할 수 있는 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템을 제공하는 것이다.

title_en: Rescue system for a collapse
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rescue system for a collapse, in which a body detection unit is installed in order to detect the presence of people inside a building, and a tilt sensor and an acceleration sensor are installed in order to set changed tilt data and acceleration data as an event trigger signal, when an earthquake or external shock occurs. Moreover, by analyzing a signal measured in the body detection unit at a predetermined time before the event trigger signal occurs, if someone was in the building before a collapse accident, the place where people are buried is announced through a voice or Morse code via an alarm unit in order to perform a rescue operation quickly. As a result, accident mortality from a collapse may be drastically reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인체 감지부를 설치하여 건축물 내부 사람의 유무를 감지하고 경사 센서와 가속도 센서를 설치하여 지진 또는 외부의 충격이 발생할 경우 변화되는 경사 데이터와 가속도 데이터를 이벤트 트리거 신호로 설정하여 이벤트 트리거 신호가 발생한 시점의 일정시간 전 인체 감지부에서 계측한 신호를 분석하여 건축물의 붕괴사고 발생 전 사람이 있을 경우 경보 알람부를 통해 사람이 매몰된 장소의 위치를 음성 또는 모스부호를 통해 경보하여 신속하게 구조 작업을 진행할 수 있도록 함으로써 붕괴에 의한 사고 사망률을 현저히 저감할 수 있는 붕괴에 따른 조난 구조 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA MAINTENANCE CO LTD;CHOI JUN SEONG;SONG JEA HWAN;KANG SUNG MIN

title_en: Portable quick dismantling equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses portable quick dismantling equipment which comprises a manual hydraulic pump, a pair of shearing pliers, a dilator and a support device. The shearing pliers, the dilator and the support device adopt hydraulic drive and are connected with the manual hydraulic pump through quick change connectors respectively. The portable quick dismantling equipment only depends on human power, is light in weight and convenient to carry and operate. The shearing pliers, the dilator and the support device can be used alternately in the sites of vehicle and railway accidents, air crash, building collapse caused by the geological disaster and beach rescue to save people quickly, so that the portable quick dismantling equipment is a desired tool for public security, fire fighting and mine emergency rescue.
assignees: HENAN LAHENG SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Novel emergency rescue refuge building platform of earthquake area transformation formula
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel earthquake belt-modified emergency rescue building platform, which is characterized in that the tops of four sides of the inner wall of the building platform are embedded with an inner frame, the bottom end of the inner frame is uniformly fixed with a plurality of vertical support plates integrated with the inner frame, the vertical support plates are embedded in the four sides of the inner wall of the building platform, and the side surfaces of the vertical support plates are vertically penetrated with at least three horizontal vertical rods, thereby providing bricks, falling rocks and the like generated when the surrounding building collapses, the bricks, falling rocks and the like can be shielded by the building platform, a helicopter can quickly find landing points in high altitude without evacuating people and then vacating a piece of empty ground to stop, thus solving the problem of the existing earthquake belt-modified novel emergency rescue building platform, building bricks and the like are easy to fall in emergency shelters and cause injury accidents of the people, the helicopter is inconvenient to land and needs a certain time to evacuate people.
assignees: SHANGHAI CHUANQIN BUILDING ENG CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake disaster reduction refuge bed cabin
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of household protection rescue equipment, and particularly relates to an earthquake disaster reduction refuge bed cabin. The earthquake shelter comprises a bed body, wherein a shelter cabin is arranged in the bed body, a plurality of cabin doors leading to the shelter cabin are arranged on the side part of the bed body, and when an earthquake suddenly occurs and people cannot escape outdoors, a refugee can rapidly enter the shelter cabin from the cabin doors on the side part. The refuge cabin body adopts a steel frame structure and is assembled by at least two frame units, the structure has high strength and stability, can effectively resist impact when a building collapses caused by an earthquake, prevents refuders from being directly pressed by the collapsed building, and provides a relatively safe shelter environment for the refuders. Meanwhile, foods and water (such as compressed biscuits and mineral water which are resistant to long-term storage) are stored and replaced in the refuge cabin at regular intervals, so that necessary dietary support is provided for refugees during waiting for rescue.
assignees: ZHONGFANG AIBAO CHENGDU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue method for building structure in fire state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue method under a fire state of a building structure, which plans a rescue advancing recommended path through a preset building collapse mode, quickly matches the most appropriate advancing path when a fire occurs, and can provide powerful guarantee for the smooth development of rescue work; meanwhile, the monitoring center can master the position of the rescue worker in real time by utilizing the positioning information of the handheld positioning terminal, so that the rescue scheme can be quickly adjusted, casualties of the rescue worker are reduced, and the method has popularization and application values.

title_en: BIM platform-based dynamic escape route optimization system for evacuation after disaster of building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM platform-based dynamic escape route optimization system for post-disaster evacuation of a building, which comprises a seismic wave data acquisition system, a structural health condition data analysis system and a structural safety early warning feedback system; the seismic wave data acquisition system acquires seismic wave data and real-time state parameters of the structure; the structural health condition data analysis system carries out screening analysis and structural damage identification on the collected data; the structure safety early warning feedback system sequentially finishes intelligent judgment of structure damage, disaster alarm, generation of an optimal escape path and escape indication according to the structure damage data, and comprises a BIM information model platform module. The invention can fully automatically monitor and feed back the structure safety condition in real time and plan an escape path in real time, can realize the integration of building structure monitoring, alarming, post-disaster rescue and repair, and has the characteristics of intellectualization, timeliness and accuracy.

title_en: Apparatus for experiencing the virtual reality
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 시민안전, 지진, 해일, 산사태, 산불, 건물붕괴, 전쟁, 기후변화, 건설현장에서 발생할 수 있는 각종 안전사고에 대한 다양한 가상환경을 각각 모듈로 구성하고, 가상체험을 위한 목적에 맞게 하나의 프레임의 천장, 벽체, 바닥부위에 모듈들을 선택적으로 조립하여 가상체험을 위한 장치를 구현하며, 체험자가 VR기기를 착용하여 장치의 내부로 진입하여 다양한 가상현실의 안전사고를 몸으로 직접 체험할 수 있도록 한 가상현실 체험장치를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은 다면체를 구현하기 위한 프레임; 상기 프레임의 각 면을 구현할 부위에 선택적으로 탈부착이 가능하도록 각각 체결되며, 안전사고 체험상황을 물리적으로 구현하는 모듈화된 구동부; 체험자가 착용하는 VR 기기; 상기 VR 기기에 디스플레이되는 가상현실 영상과 매칭되도록 상기 구동부의 구동을 제어하는 제어부;로 구성된다.

title_en: Method for extinguishing fire by using flue gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extinguishing fire by using flue gas, which comprises the following steps of: 1, collecting the stored flue gas: compressing the flue gas exhausted to a chimney by a boiler into a mobile gas storage tank or a fixed gas storage tank by using an air compressor, wherein the output end of the fixed gas storage tank is communicated with a gas pipeline of a user side through a building gas pipe network; 2, collocating an air respirator for emergency escape of a wearer indoors; 3, inflating gas to the room to extinguish fire: when a fire disaster happens, automatically opening a pipeline valve communicated with the fixed gas storage tank indoors by a trapped person to inflate the gas to the room to extinguish fire; supplying the flue gas to the fixed gas storage tank in time by a rescuer, or closing the pipeline valve at the output end in time according to the fire extinguishing condition; and 4, performing safe escape, namely the trapped person wears the air respirator and escapes the danger zone per se. By using the flue gas to extinguish the fire, the fire is extinguished quickly, the effect is good, articles are not damaged, building collapse accidents and personnel burn can be prevented, fire spread is effectively controlled, the escape time for trapped persons is prolonged, and the method has unique advantages of fire extinguishment of high-rise buildings.

title_en: Multifunctional life safe box
abstract_en: A multifunctional life safe box is formed by thin steel plates and buffer materials or inflaming retarding sealing layers. Multiple reinforcing ribs are pressed or welded on the planes of the rectangular thin steel plates, load bearing strength is increased, and the overall weight is lightened. In order to facilitate manufacturing, disassembling, assembling and transportation, the safe box is divided into a top part, a bottom part, four walls, a door and a bed plate to be manufactured. Rust-proof treatment is carried out for the manufactured thin steel plates. The buffer materials are contained below the top part, on middle upper portions of the four walls, inside the door and on the bed plate. A partition plate is arranged below the bed plate and used for storing articles and self-rescue tools. After assembling, the safe box is a rectangular container type metal outer shell, and the interior of the safe box is a hexahedral space containing the buffer materials. Once a violent earthquake happens, as long as people sleep or hide in the safe box, even through a building collapses, the safe box rolls over and falls to the ground, building debris can only impact or extrude the metal outer shell, and even a part of the safe box is damaged or buried in the ruins, people in the safe box cannot be injured, people are injured at the most but cannot die, and life and property safety of people can be ensured.

title_en: Building collapse rescue simulation test method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of collapse rescue simulation and discloses a building collapse rescue simulation test method, which is characterized in that image data in a collapse simulation scene is recorded through a camera module, and meanwhile, information of the sensor touched by a life detector is recorded through a first sensor and a second sensor, so that a tester can timely obtain test feedback, the proficiency of the tested person in operating the life detector is improved in a test substitution mode, meanwhile, after the test, the defect in operation of the life detector can be purposefully complemented through reviewing the image data and definitely confirming the defects of the tested person, so that the existing problems are purposefully improved, the detection skill of the life detector is improved, the detection efficiency and the rescue efficiency of the rescuer in formal rescue are improved, and the rescue success rate is improved.
assignees: CHONGQING VOCATIONAL INST ENG;CHONGQING XIANCHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus, system and control method for people counting
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a people counting apparatus and a system and control method thereof and, more specifically, to a people counting apparatus including a lighting function and a disaster detection function, and a system and control method thereof. According to the present invention, the people counting apparatus detects a counting target passing a detection area and determines whether the counting target is a person to generate information about the number of counted persons, thereby counting the number of people passing the detection area. The people counting apparatus provides the lighting function lighting a predetermined range including the detection area. The people counting apparatus transmits the information on the number of people counted on the basis of an ad-hook network to other nodes or gateways, thereby facilitating installation and operation regardless of indoor or outdoor. The people counting apparatus provides a disaster detection function to detect occurrence of disaster situations such as building collapses, earthquakes, fires, and gas leaks and is configured to supply auxiliary power when operating power supply is cut off or the disaster situation is detected, thereby propagating information about a disaster situation or a rescue target even when operating power is cut off due to a disaster. The people counting apparatus comprises a sensing unit, a lighting unit, a control unit, and a communication unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 구체적으로는 조명 기능과 재난 감지 기능을 구비하는 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한, 본 발명은 감지 영역을 지나는 카운팅 대상을 감지하고 카운팅 대상이 사람인지 판정하여 카운팅된 사람의 수에 대한 정보를 생성함으로써, 감지 영역을 지나는 사람의 수를 카운팅할 수 있고, 감지 영역을 포함하는 소정의 범위에 빛을 비추는 조명 기능을 제공하며, 애드훅 네트워크를 기반으로 카운팅된 사람의 수에 대한 정보를 타 노드 또는 게이트웨이에 송신하도록 구비됨으로써, 실내나 실외의 구분없이 설치 및 운용이 용이하며, 건물 붕괴, 지진, 화재 및 가스 누출을 포함하는 재난 상황의 발생 여부를 감지하는 재난 감지 기능을 제공하며, 동작 전원 공급이 차단되거나 재난 상황이 감지되는 경우 보조 전원을 공급하도록 구비됨으로써, 재난으로 인해 동작 전원이 차단된 상황에서도 재난 상황이나 구조 대상에 대한 정보의 전파가 가능하다.

title_en: Random number generation method and random number generator using inorganic scintillator
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 ZnS 섬광체를 이용한 난수생성방법 및 난수생성장치에 대한 것으로, 원자핵의 자연붕괴시 알파입자 또는 베타입자를 방출하는 방사성 동위 원소 방출층과, 상기 방사성 동위 원소 방출층의 하단에 배치되는 폴리머층과, 상기 방사성 동위원소방출층과 상기 폴리머층 사이에 배치되며 무기섬광물질이 도포되는 무기섬광체층과, 상기 폴리머층 하단에 배치되고 상기 무기섬광체층으로부터 발생하는 빛을 검출하는 포토다이오드를 포함하는 웨이퍼층을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Numerical simulation method for quickly constructing building collapsed ruin lifesaving channel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake field rescue, in particular to a numerical simulation method for quickly constructing collapsed ruin lifesaving channels of buildings. The method comprises the following steps: (1) And establishing a building structure numerical model by adopting an ANSYS/LS-DYNA program, generating a KEYWORDS file 1, and then solving to generate a D3DUMP file. (2) Modifying the KEYWORDS file, adding a keyword STRESS _ INITIALIZATION, and keeping the STRESS state of the collapsed ruin numerical model. (3) Performing 'secondary editing' on the structural collapse ruin numerical model, adding a keyword DELETE _ ELEMENT, and deleting a component unit to realize removal and breaking rescue technology in the rescue process. (4) And generating a new KEYWORDS file 1+i (i =1,2,3 …), and realizing the construction of the ruin numerical model lifesaving channel. The numerical simulation method for quickly constructing the building collapse ruin lifesaving channel can provide scientific and reliable basis for quickly determining the rescue direction and constructing the lifesaving channel for commanders in earthquake sites.

title_en: Multifunctional barrier-breaking rescue robot for mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional mine barrier-breaking rescue robot which comprises a rescue vehicle, wherein a barrier cleaning device is arranged at the front end of the rescue vehicle, an anti-collapse auxiliary device positioned above the barrier cleaning device is arranged at the front end of the rescue vehicle, a plurality of anti-collapse supporting steel beams are driven by a three-dimensional driving mechanism to move to the front of a barrier below a collapse position, then the anti-collapse supporting steel beams are controlled to be inserted into the barrier in front, so that the collapse position is supported by the anti-collapse supporting steel beams, and then the barrier cleaning device starts to clean the barrier, so that the possibility of secondary collapse caused by the barrier cleaning device cleaning the barrier is greatly reduced, the barrier-breaking rescue efficiency is favorably improved, and the safety of rescuers, trapped persons and rescue equipment is guaranteed.
assignees: ANHUI TECHNICAL COLLEGE MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL ENG

title_en: Virtual training method and system for firefighter search and rescue escape
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of virtual training, in particular to a method and a system for virtual training of firefighter search and rescue escape, wherein the system comprises a virtual scene dynamic construction module, a door and a channel are abstracted into sides giving geometric distance weight according to a building plan, a room intersection and a corridor intersection are abstracted into nodes, the fire spreading or structure collapse event is responded in the virtual training, the weight of the corresponding sides is adjusted to infinity, a shortest path is obtained, and a reference rescue path set is established. According to the invention, through dynamic analysis of structural information of the building plan, intersections of rooms and hallways are abstracted into nodes, doors and channels are abstracted into sides with geometric weights, accessibility of the sides is adjusted in real time after fire spread or structural collapse occurs, non-passable conditions are introduced in calculating paths, and real-time adaptability and rescue simulation precision of the path generation process are improved.

title_en: Smart Emergency Exit Lamp
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피난구 유도등에 관한 것으로서, 특히 재해/재난 등으로 건물붕괴 및 화재 등의 비상상황 발생시 피난구의 방향표시 기능은 유지한 채 휴대가능한 비상등이 손전등으로 분리되어 후레쉬와 조난신호 전송 기능을 하여 인명구조에 적극 활용되는 스마트 피난구 유도등에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여, 본 발명은 건물 벽체에 지지되도록 설치되고, 비상시 점등되는 피난구 유도등이 구비되는 베이스 비상등; 및 상기 베이스 비상등에 부착된 상태로 내장 배터리에 의해 상시 충전되고 피난구 유도등이 구비되어 상시 점등되며, 비상시 베이스 비상등으로부터 분리되면서 후레쉬 램프가 점등되고 조난신호를 일정 시간마다 전송하는 포터블 비상등; 을 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 베이스 비상등은 포터블 비상등의 분리시 피난구 유도등이 점등되는 것을 특징으로 하는 스마트 피난구 유도등을 제공한다.

title_en: Earthquake life-saving device
abstract_en: Disclosed is an earthquake life-saving device, which includes a casing (1), an entry-exit opening provided at the lower part of the casing (1), vents (3) set at the upper part of the casing, a handle (5) mounted on the inner wall of the casing (1), and a signal emission device (6) provided on the casing (1). The life-saving device is set in an above-ground building where human beings live, work or exercise. During the short period of time when the earthquake happens, a person can quickly enter the life-saving device, close the entry-exit opening and the vents, stabilize oneself and grasp the handle. When the building collapses during the earthquake, the life-saving device can slide down along with the damaged parts of the building, protecting the person inside from being bumped, crushed, squeezed or pricked by the broken objects of the building, thereby protecting the life of the person. The signal emission device can emit a rescue signal at regular intervals to facilitate rescue.

title_en: Jib bracket
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a jib bracket capable of hanging down a rope up to the ground surface for helping oneself, which is required because the Government and News warns that a huge earthquake will occur in Southern Kanto, and it is unknown whether or not a building collapses at the earthquake, and if a huge earthquake occurs, a disaster victim can obtain relief supplies for protecting his/her own life only when he/she goes to a refuge place by oneself and registers himself/herself as a victim, in a situation that the first floor and the midway floor of a mid-to-high-rise building collapse like in the Great Hanshin earthquake, the collapsed ceiling blocks up an evacuation passage in the building, so the disaster victim is unable to go to the outside ground from the inside of a building, and there is a possibility in a big city that the disaster victim who survives the earthquake disaster runs out of food and water and dies of hunger because whether or not a rescue party comes is uncertain due to the numerous population.SOLUTION: A rope support is mounted on an outer wall of a building structure, and a rope is attached to the tip of a jib in a hand-reachable place from a veranda and a window having a floor. An arm is turned and fixed at a right angle to the wall surface after a state in which a person can safely hang on the rope is established, and the rope is hung down at a position separate from the building structure.

title_en: Disaster situation communication network infrastructure supplementation method and system using unmanned mobile device
title_ko: 무인이동체 장치를 활용한 재난상황 통신 네트워크 인프라 보완방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: An apparatus for building a communication network and collecting situation information in a field of a collapse disaster according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a ground drone (10) traveling by means of driving of a track device (20) and having a communication device (80) mounted thereon; a flying drone (32) mounted on the ground drone (10) to be transferred and flying according to an operational signal to photograph a field of a collapse disaster; a camera device (40) mounted on the ground drone (10) to photograph the surroundings of the ground drone (10); storage (50) installed on the ground drone (10) to accommodate a relay module (60) and throw the relay module (60) into the field of the collapse disaster according to an operational signal; and a plurality of relay modules (60) connected through a wireless communication network to relay wireless communication among the ground drone (10), the flying drone (32), and a directing control unit (100). Accordingly, situation information on a disaster field can be more accurately ensured and shared and a rescue plan can be made in a safer manner.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 붕괴 재난 현장에서 통신망 구축 및 상황정보 수집하는 장치는, 궤도 장치(20)의 구동으로 주행하고 통신 장치(80)가 탑재된 지상 드론(10); 지상 드론(10)에 탑재되어 운반되고, 작동 신호에 따라 비행하여 붕괴 재난 현장을 촬영하는 비행 드론(32); 지상 드론(10)에 탑재되어 지상 드론(10)의 주변을 촬영하는 카메라 장치(40); 지상 드론(10)에 설치되고 중계기 모듈(60)을 수납하며 작동 신호에 따라 중계기 모듈(60)을 붕괴 재난 현장에 투척하는 스토리지(50); 및 무선 통신망으로 연결되어 지상 드론(10), 비행 드론(32) 및 지휘 통제부(100) 간에 무선 통신을 중계하는 다수의 중계기 모듈(60); 을 포함한다.

title_en: Protective device for landslide rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protective device for landslide rescue, which comprises a plurality of protective pipe bodies connected end to end, wherein crawling ladders are fixed in the protective pipe bodies, and the crawling ladders in the adjacent protective pipe bodies are connected end to end; a clamping mechanism is further arranged between the protective pipe bodies and used for connecting and fastening two adjacent sections of the protective pipe bodies; the inboard of protection body still is provided with a plurality of stiffeners, the stiffener top is provided with the plug, and the bottom is provided with the socket, and is adjacent the protection body the stiffener pass through the plug with the socket end to end. According to the protection device for collapse rescue, the protection pipe body covers the periphery of the rescue personnel, so that the damage of secondary collapse to the rescue personnel is effectively prevented, and the protection pipe bodies are structurally provided with the reinforcing rods and the like, so that the structural strength is enhanced, and the safety of rescue work is improved.

title_en: A kind of method that novel particle builds assembled device and assembly
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of method that novel particle builds assembled device and assembly,Include the individual particle of series of identical moulding,The particle is six cube structures,The middle position in six faces of the particle is equipped with perforate,The wherein symmetrical two sides of the particle is equipped with some small sircle holes,The small sircle hole is located at the periphery of perforate,The series of identical moulding particle is mutually connected to each other by connection strap,It can realize that diversification is built in life,Convenience in transport,It is easily manufactured,Save material,Recycle,And the moulding of the unique setting of the particle is more stable and firm than conventional construction material,And reduce the complicated coagulation process of conventional construction material,The building that the principle of the particle is more beneficial for being in quake zone country is built,Some fritters can be dispersed into during the building collapse built with the granular materials and mitigate weight,Directly people or thing will not be caused death or damaged,Or temporary shelter constructions when combating a natural disaster rescue are built.

title_en: Fire extinguisher including hammer
abstract_en: A hammer-integrated fire extinguisher according to an embodiment of the present invention, which is configured so as to perform the functions of a fire extinguisher and a hammer which are individually disposed within an airplane, comprises: a main body container in which a fire extinguishing agent is compressed to be stored therein; a hammer unit fastened to a lower portion of the main body container such that a user can grip the main body container and hit a wall body in order to destroy the wall body; and a fastening unit fastening the hammer unit to the lower portion of the main body container. Therefore, the present invention reduces the overall weight of an airplane, and simplifies processes required for using emergency equipment, thereby improving safety in rescuing human lives in case of an emergency.
abstract_ko: 항공기 내에 각각 개별 비치되는 소화기와 해머의 기능을 함께 수행할 수 있도록 한 본 발명에 따른 해머 일체형 소화기는 소화약제가 압축 내장된 본체용기, 사용자가 상기 본체용기를 파지하고 벽체를 타격하여 상기 벽체를 파괴할 수 있도록 상기 본체용기의 하부에 결속되는 해머부 및 상기 해머부를 상기 본체용기의 하부에 결속시키는 결속부를 포함하므로, 항공기 전체 중량을 절감할 수 있으며, 비상 장비를 이용하는 절차를 단순화하여 비상시 인명구조 안전성을 향상시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Indoor monitoring system using augmented reality
title_ko: 증강현실을 이용한 실내 위치 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system to monitor an indoor location by using augmented reality (AR), comprising: a plurality of indoor transmitters installed inside a building to transmit a signal for determining a location of an indoor staff entering the building; indoor staff equipment held by the indoor staff, and determining the location of the indoor staff based on radio positioning or dead reckoning, or by integrating radio positioning and dead reckoning; a plurality of outdoor transmitters installed outside the building and transmitting a signal for determining a location of an observation staff who monitors the indoor staff in the outside; observation staff equipment held by the observation staff, and receiving location information of the outdoor transmitter and a wireless signal capable of measuring a distance to determine the location of the observation staff; and a central processing server receiving the location information of the indoor staff from the indoor staff equipment and the observation staff equipment to determine a relative location, and calculating an eyeline vector of the observation staff to generate an image capable of being displayed as AR in the observation staff equipment. Thus, since location information of a rescue staff placed in a building is provided when rescue activity is deployed in an accident scene of fire, collapse, etc., efficient rescue activity deployment and safety of the rescue staff can be ensured.
abstract_ko: 상술한 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명에 따른 증강현실을 이용한 실내 위치 모니터링 시스템은 실내에 설치되어 실내에 진입한 내부요원의 위치를 결정하기 위한 신호를 송신하는 복수의 실내 송신기; 실내요원이 착용하고 전파측위 기반, 추측항법 기반, 또는 전파측위와 추측항법을 통합하여 실내요원의 위치를 결정하는 내부요원 장비; 실외에 설치되어 실외에서 실내요원을 모니텅링하기 위한 관측요원의 위치를 결정하기 위한 신호를 송신하는 복수의 실외 송신기; 관측요원이 착용하고 실외 송신기의 설치된 위치정보와 거리 측정이 가능한 무선신호를 수신하여 상기 관측요원의 위치를 결정하는 관측요원 장비; 내부요원 장비와 관측요원 장비로부터 각각 실내요원 위치정보와 관측요원 위치정보 수신하여, 상대위치를 결정하고 관측요원의 시선벡터를 계산하여 관측요원 장비에 증강현실로 디스플레이될 수 있는 영상을 생성하는 중앙처리 서버;를 포함하여, 화재 및 붕괴 사고 등의 현장에서 구조 활동 전개 시, 실내에 위치한 구조요원의 위치 정보를 제공함으로써, 효율적인 구조 활동 전개는 물론 구조요원의 안전을 확보할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Modular pump assembly and pump module for use therein
abstract_en: The group of inventions relates to modular pump assemblies and can be used for pumping large volumes of fluid using at least one pump module. Both the claimed pump assembly and the claimed pump module can be incorporated into mobile firefighting stations. A modular pump assembly comprises at least one pump module, each of which comprises a frame 1 and, mounted therein, an electric motor, a reduction gear, and a pump for pumping fluid. The frame 1 of each pump module is designed so that at least one other pump module can be detachably connected to the frame 1. The invention is directed toward: providing a broader scope of use by increasing the options for the spatial configuration of modular pump assemblies with pumps so that they can be compactly housed in small and narrow rooms or in low-volume containers in the event of transportation; simplifying the process of regulating the capacity of a pump assembly by adjusting the number of connected modules; and enhancing the structural integrity of the pump assembly and its resistance to vibrations.

title_en: Method for quickly identifying post-earthquake structural damage based on flexibility change rate and pattern matching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly identifying post-earthquake structural damage based on flexibility change rate and pattern matching, which comprises the following steps of: establishing a finite element model of the structure, and carrying out modal analysis on various damage working conditions; calculating the flexibility change rate of the injury to form an injury mode library; carrying out modal identification on the structure dynamic response, and calculating a matching vector to form a test set; and (5) carrying out similarity measurement on the matching vectors in the test set and a pattern library in sequence, and judging the damage position and the damage degree according to the matching result. The method has the advantages of small calculation amount and high calculation speed; the influence of excitation can be eliminated, so that the established damage mode library is not influenced by external environmental factors; the damage position and the damage degree can be efficiently and quickly identified, and the defect that the damage degree cannot be quantified by the traditional method for identifying the structural damage based on the flexibility matrix is overcome. Therefore, the method is suitable for damage and safety evaluation of the structure after the earthquake, and has great significance for emergency rescue and emergency decision after the earthquake.

title_en: Rescue system for a collapse
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rescue system for a collapse, in which a body detection unit is installed in order to detect the presence of people inside a building, and a tilt sensor and an acceleration sensor are installed in order to set changed tilt data and acceleration data as an event trigger signal, when an earthquake or external shock occurs. Moreover, by analyzing a signal measured in the body detection unit at a predetermined time before the event trigger signal occurs, if someone was in the building before a collapse accident, the place where people are buried is announced through a voice or Morse code via an alarm unit in order to perform a rescue operation quickly. As a result, accident mortality from a collapse may be drastically reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인체 감지부를 설치하여 건축물 내부 사람의 유무를 감지하고 경사 센서와 가속도 센서를 설치하여 지진 또는 외부의 충격이 발생할 경우 변화되는 경사 데이터와 가속도 데이터를 이벤트 트리거 신호로 설정하여 이벤트 트리거 신호가 발생한 시점의 일정시간 전 인체 감지부에서 계측한 신호를 분석하여 건축물의 붕괴사고 발생 전 사람이 있을 경우 경보 알람부를 통해 사람이 매몰된 장소의 위치를 음성 또는 모스부호를 통해 경보하여 신속하게 구조 작업을 진행할 수 있도록 함으로써 붕괴에 의한 사고 사망률을 현저히 저감할 수 있는 붕괴에 따른 조난 구조 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA MAINTENANCE CO LTD;CHOI JUN SEONG;SONG JEA HWAN;KANG SUNG MIN

title_en: Emergency road block device driver
abstract_en: The present invention is installed on a ramp of bridges or an entrance of flooded roads or tunnel. An emergency roadblock device is used to prevent vehicles from entering if an emergency such as collapsing of bridges, roads, or tunnel, automobile accidents, and renovation thereof have occurred. A roll screen descended in an emergency is easily fluttered in strong winds but is not folded, and a receiving chamber mounted with the roll screen can be horizontally moved along a guide rail which is provided on a horizontal frame, thereby completely resolving factors of an accident during the renovation and traffic problems.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 교량이나 침수도로 터널 등의 진입로에 설치되어 교량이나 도로 도는 터널의 붕괴나 차량사고 또는 이들의 개보수 등과 같은 비상사태가 발생하는 경우 작동하여 차량이 진입하는 것을 차단하여 주는데 사용되는 긴급 도로운행 차단장치에 관한 것으로 비상사태발생시 하강시킨 롤스크린이 강풍에도 쉽게 휘날리면서 접히지 않도록 하여 주고, 
롤스크린이 내장된 수용함체를 수평프레임에 구비된 안내레일을 타고 좌,우로 이동가능한 이동식으로 구성하여 개보수시 인적사고의 위험과 교통장애의 요인을 완벽하게 해소하여 줌은 물론, 
롤스크린에 새겨진 경고문구나 문양 등을 간접발광체가 아닌 전원의 공급에 의한 직접발광체로 구성하여 야간이나 흐린 날씨에도 경고문구나 문양이 선명하게 식별 가능하도록 하여 운전자의 안전을 더욱 효과적으로 꾀할 수 있는 특수한 구성의 긴급 도로운행 차단장치를 제공하고자 함에 그 목적을 둔 것이다. 
상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명의 긴급 도로운행 차단장치는 기본적으로 터널입구 상단에 직접 고정설치되거나 또는 터널입구 전방 진입로에 설치되는 각종 형태의 지주에 수평으로 고정설치되는 수평프레임(2)에 설치되는 수용함체(100)내에 장착된 제1정역모터(10)에 의해 정,역회전하는 구동축(11)에 귄취되어 감겨지거나 풀려지면서 경고문구(21)나 문양이 새겨진 롤스크린(20)을 승,하강시켜 운전자에게 비상사태 발생을 알려주는 긴급 도로운행 차단장치에 있어서, 
상기 긴급 도로운행 차단장치는, 
각각 제1아암(210)과 제2아암(220)으로 이루어져 내측으로 접혀지도록 힌지(201)결합된 한쌍의 절첩식아암(200)을 제조하여 각각의 절첩식아암(200) 상단은 롤스크린(20)이 귄취된 구동축(11) 전방의 수용함체(100) 상부 양측에 각각 힌지(202)결합하고, 
각각의 절첩식아암(200)의 하단은 롤스크린(20) 배면에 수평으로 배치되는 뒤틀림방지대(230)의 좌,우 양측에 결합되어 롤스크린(20)의 양단을 감싸고 있는 "ㄷ"형 절곡편(231)에 힌지(203)결합하되, 
상기 롤스크린(20)의 상부 좌,우 양측단에는 롤스크린(20)의 하강시 "ㄷ"형 절곡편(231)에 걸리면서 절첩식아암(200)이 하측으로 펼쳐지도록 보조하는 상측걸림편(241)을 형성하고, 
상기 롤스크린(20)의 하부 좌,우 양측단에는 롤스크린(20)의 승강시 "ㄷ"형 절곡편(231)에 걸리면서 절첩식아암(200)이 상측으로 접혀지도록 하는 하측걸림편(242)을 형성하여서, 
비상사태 발생시 롤스크린(20)을 하강시키면 절첩식아암(200)이 동시에 펼쳐져 롤스크린(20)의 상부를 최대한 파지하여 줌으로서 롤스크린(20)이 강풍이 불어도 뒤틀리지 않고 펼쳐진 상태가 지속적으로 유지되도록 이루어진 것에 그 특징이 있는 것이다.

title_en: Rescue structure for seismic reinforcement of school buildings and facilitating emergency evacuation during earthquakes
title_ko: 학교 건축물의 내진 보강 및 지진발생 시 긴급 대피가 용이한 구호용 구조물
abstract_en: The present invention can be applied to both existing and newly-constructed school buildings, can help prevent collapse by dissipating seismic energy during an earthquake, and at the same time, can facilitate floor-by-floor emergency evacuation during emergency situations such as earthquakes or fires.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기존에 건축 된 학교는 물론 신축 학교에도 적용 가능하며, 지진발생 시 지진에너지의 소산 효과로 붕괴 예방에 일익을 담당할 수 있음과 동시에 지진, 화재 등의 긴급 지진 발생 시 층별 긴급 대피가 용이하다.

title_en: Emergency escape wireless transmitter
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency escape wireless transmitter is provided to alarm a speaker warning sound in a receiver attached to the inside of the helmet and to increase the safety of a fire fighter. CONSTITUTION: An emergency escape wireless transmitter includes a reception speaker(3), an LED lamp(5), an reception antenna(4), and a transmitter(6). The reception speaker is installed inside the helmet. The LED lamp is installed inside the helmet. The reception antenna is installed in the outside of the helmet. The transmitter includes a button(7) and transmission antenna(8).
