title_en: waterfront Structure Integrating management system based on GIS(Geographical Information System)
title_ko: 자연재해에 따른 수변구조물의 피해정보를 실시간으로 예측／관리 가능한 gis 기반의 수변구조물 통합관리시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a geographical information system (GIS)-based integrated waterfront structure management system capable of real-time prediction and management of information on damage to a waterfront structure caused by a natural disaster. The GIS-based integrated waterfront structure management system comprises: a waterfront structure measurement module (100) measuring behavior of a waterfront structure caused by a natural disaster; a data logging server (200) collecting behavior information of the waterfront structure measured by the waterfront structure measurement module (100) in real time through a wireless interface, and classifying and logging the same according to a type and geographical position of the waterfront structure, and a type of the natural disaster; a monitoring server (300) predicting, stage by stage, and monitoring predicted damage information of the waterfront structure including at least one among flooding, erosion, breakage, collapse, seepage, scour, fracture, exposure of a bar, bending, deformation, and piping which may occur in the waterfront structure due to the natural disaster, based on the logged information classified by the data logging server (200); and a waterfront structure management server (400) providing a disaster warning message to portable terminals of a manager charged with maintenance of the waterfront structure and a local resident of the area where the waterfront structure is installed, and to a management server of National Emergency Management agency, if the predicted damage information of each stage predicted by the monitoring server (300) exceeds predetermined reference predicted damage information.
abstract_ko: 자연재해에 따른 수변구조물의 피해정보를 실시간으로 예측/관리 가능한 GIS 기반의 수변구조물 통합관리시스템은 자연재해로 인한 수변구조물의 거동을 계측하는 수변구조물 계측모듈(100); 무선 인터페이스를 통해 상기 수변구조물 계측모듈(100)에서 계측된 상기 수변구조물의 거동정보를 실시간으로 수집한 후, 상기 수변구조물의 종류, 지리적 위치, 자연재해의 종류에 따라 분류하여 로깅하는 데이터 로깅서버(200); 상기 데이터 로깅서버(200)에서 분류된 로깅정보들에 기반하여, 상기 자연재해로 인하여 상기 수변구조물에서 발생 가능한 범람, 유실, 파손, 붕괴, 침수, 침투, 세굴, 균열, 철근노출, 휨, 이격, 변형, 파이핑 중 적어도 하나 이상이 포함된 수변구조물의 예상피해정보를 단계별로 예측 및 모니터링하는 모니터링 서버(300); 및 상기 모니터링 서버(300)에서 예측된 단계별 예상피해정보가 상기 수변구조물에 따라 설정된 기준예상피해정보를 초과할 경우, 상기 수변구조물의 유지보수 관리자, 상기 수변구조물이 설치된 지역의 지역주민의 휴대단말 및 소방재청의 관리서버로 재난경고메시지를 제공하는 수변구조물 관리서버(400);를 포함한다.

title_en: Laminated elastomeric bearing having ability of safety check-up for bridge
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bridge seat apparatus having a bridge safety diagnosis function which senses deformation acting on an upper plate of a bridge when an earthquake occurs to notify a vehicle passing on the bridge and a remote manager of the deformation of the upper plate of the bridge, and blocks the entrance of the bridge to restrict vehicles if the deformation of the upper plate of the bridge exceeds a prescribed range. According to the present invention, the bridge seat apparatus having a bridge safety diagnosis function comprises: an upper pad fixed on a lower portion of an upper plate of a bridge by an anchor bolt; a lower pad fixed on an upper surface of a bridge post by an anchor bolt to correspond to the upper pad; and an impact absorbing pad arranged between the upper and the lower pad. The bridge seat apparatus having a bridge safety diagnosis function further comprises: a first sensor consisting of a gyroscope sensor attached to a lower surface of the upper pad to sense an inclination angle by vibration; a second sensor consisting of a micrometer attached to an upper surface of the lower pad in an X-axis and a Y-axis to sense a movement of the axes; and a third sensor consisting of a height gate attached to one side of the upper and the lower pad to sense vertical compression. Sensing signals of the sensors are monitored in real time to measure and check a bridge seat exceeding a prescribed range, and then the bridge is controlled as needed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진 발생시의 교량 상판에 작용하는 변형을 감지하여 교량을 통과하는 차량과 원거리의 관리자에게 교량 상판의 변형을 알려주며, 교량 상판의 변형이 일정 범위를 벗어나는 경우 교량의 진입로를 차단하여 차량을 통제할 수 있는 교량 안전진단 기능을 갖는 교좌장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 의한 교량 안전진단 기능을 갖는 교좌장치는, 앵커볼트에 의해 교량 상판의 저부에 고정되는 상부패드와, 교각의 상면에 상기 상부패드와 대응되도록 앵커볼트에 의해 고정되는 하부패드와, 그 사이에 개재되는 완충패드로 구성되되, 상부패드의 저면에 부착되어 진동에 따른 기울기 각도를 감지하는 자이로스코프 센서로 된 제1감지기, 하부패드의 상면에 x축과 y축으로 각각 부착되어 축의 이동량을 감지하는 마이크로미터로 된 제2감지기, 및 상하부 패드의 일측면에 부착되어 상하 압축량을 감지하는 하이트 게이트로 된 제3감지기를 포함하여 이들 감지기의 감지신호를 실시간 모니터링하여 일정 변위를 벗어나는 교좌를 측정 확인 후 필요에 따라 교량을 통제하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Digital twinning technology-based fire scene collapse risk early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire scene collapse risk early warning method based on a digital twin technology, which belongs to the technical field of fire scene collapse risk early warning, and mainly adopts the following scheme: acquiring fire scene building environment information, establishing a fire scene building environment digital twin model according to the fire scene building environment information, and determining a collapse initial profile according to the floor temperature distribution information of a combustion area; determining an additional collapse profile; determining collapse risk level by using the thickness information of the floor slab in the burning area and the weight information of the articles on the floor slab in the burning area; determining a predicted collapse profile according to the additional collapse profile and the initial collapse profile; and when the position of the firefighter is coincident with the predicted collapse profile, the predicted collapse profile information and the collapse risk level are timely sent to the firefighter so as to realize collapse risk early warning, and the firefighter in the collapse area is early warned, so that casualties caused by collapse of the building in a fire disaster are effectively avoided.

title_en: Passive disconnect-type snake-like robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a passive separation type snake-shaped robot, which comprises a head, a control unit, an external environment detection unit and a battery unit, wherein the head comprises a head shell, and the control unit, the external environment detection unit and the battery unit are arranged on the head shell; the body part comprises a plurality of separable joint modules which are sequentially connected to form a chain structure and joint driving motors arranged between every two adjacent separable joint modules; the separable joint module comprises a module I, a module II and a connecting assembly; when the building collapses and is pressed by gravity, the pressed part stops moving, the part which is not pressed continues moving to transmit power, so that the spring in the connecting device drives the steel ball to be separated from the spherical groove, the pressed part is separated from the whole body to stop working, the part which is not pressed continues working under the leading of the snake head, and the disaster scene is transmitted to the rescue workers through the miniature camera, thereby improving the rescue working efficiency.

title_en: The unmanned air vehicle for castaway tracking
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 몸체와 정면을 촬영하는 카메라, 외부의 소리를 입력 받을 수 있는 마이크, 소리를 외부로 전달 가능한 스피커, 이동 방향을 지향하는 지향성 안테나, 장애물을 감지하는 근접센서, 주변의 환경 상태를 감지하는 환경센서, 및 제어 정보를 전달하는 조종 안테나를 포함하는 무인 비행체를 투입하여 화재현장이나 붕괴현장과 같은 각종 재해현장에서 피치 못할 상황으로 대피하지 못한 조난자를 구조하는데 있어서, 고 위험의 현장에 인력을 투입하는 대신 신속하게 조난자를 탐색하여, 구조대가 투입될 수 있는 안전한 경로를 제공하는데 관한 것이다.

title_en: A alarm for saving a life
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a personal life saving alarm comprises: a case main body, and a main board. And a beacon, which is a wireless communication module, is installed in the personal life saving alarm to enable the personal life saving alarm to track a position of a firefighter, thereby easily recognizing a firefighter buried in a fire scene, and to verify personal information of firefighters entering the fire scene and a maximum entry maintaining time from a firefighting command center away from the fire scene, thereby considering safety of the entering firefighters.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 개인인명구조용 경보기는, 배면에 버클이 부착되고 전면에 이머전시 키와 상기 이머전시 키를 둘러싸는 LED 링이 배치된 케이스본체와, 상기 케이스본체의 측면에 인출작동이 가능하게 작동 키가 설치되고, 해제버튼이 설치되고, 상부측면에 LED 표시창이 설치되고 타측면에 모드키 및 접속부가 설치되고 내부에 움직임 감지 센서와 RTD센서가 설치되고, 비콘이 설치되고, 상기 비콘과 접속되며 경보음을 발생하는 부저와 배터리와 연결되며 상기 LED 링과 LCD 표시창과 연결된 메인보드를 포함하여, 화재 또는 각종 재난현장에 출동하는 소방관등의 안전과 출동현장의 현황을 파악하여 현장을 효율적으로 지휘하기 위하여 소방관등이 화재 또는 각종 재난현장에 출동 시에 소방관들이 착용한 소방복상에 걸어서 착용할 수가 있으며 착용이 용이하고, 화재현장에 진입한 소방관의 움직임이 없으면 경보음을 출력하고 LED가 점멸작동되고 화재현장에 설정된 온도이상의 고온의 온도가 감지되게 되면 경보음을 출력하고 LED가 점멸작동되어 위험한 현장을 식별하여 붕괴사고가 발생될 위험한 현장을 알려주며 화재현장의 진입시간과 현재시간이 표시되어 용이하게 착용한 소방관이 진입시간과 현재시간을 파악할 수가 있으며 무선통신모듈인 비콘이 설치되어 소방관의 위치의 추적이 가능하게 되어 화재현장에서 매몰된 소방관을 용이하게 인지하며 화재현장에서 떨어진 소방지휘소에서 화재현장에 진입한 소방관들의 인적사항과 진입시간의 파악이 가능하게 되어 최대진입유지시간의 파악으로 인하여 진입 소방관들의 안전을 고려하는 것이 가능한 우수한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Disaster-avoiding bed for high-rise building
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of furniture, in particular to a high-rise disaster-avoiding bed. The disaster-avoiding bed starts the traction mechanism through a sensor or a button arranged on the bed body, so that the bearing mechanism in a daily state can be quickly opened and fall down, and the hatch cover can be closed, and the purpose of quickly forming a disaster-avoiding space can be achieved. The high-strength heat insulation material adopted by the disaster-avoiding bed can bear huge impact force brought by the earthquake and fire when a building collapses, protects the safety of disaster-avoiding personnel, and is not secondarily damaged when the building is excavated and searched and rescued by large-scale machinery. The double-layer heat insulation plate structure and the sealing edge structure adopted by the disaster-avoiding bed have the functions of sealing and heat insulation, and effectively isolate high temperature and smoke during fire. The emergency box is arranged to ensure the life needs of disaster-avoiding personnel and provide search and rescue positioning information. The foldable mattress or the soft mattress can fall along with the bearing plate, thereby greatly shortening the time of forming a disaster-avoiding space. The invention has the advantages of ingenious design and reasonable structure, and is suitable for popularization and use in the technical field of furniture.

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot car
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake rescue robot vehicle which comprises a vehicle body, crawler wheel sets, mechanical arms, water spraying assemblies and mechanical arms, wherein the crawler wheels are assembled on two sides of the vehicle body, the crawler wheel sets are connected with driving assemblies which are used for driving the crawler wheel sets to rotate, when searching and rescuing, the contact area between the crawler wheel sets and the ground is large, the condition that a crawler falls into mud to idle in situ is avoided, meanwhile, the crawler wheel sets can climb a building to search and rescue, meanwhile, the mechanical arms can partially support a dangerous building to avoid secondary collapse of the dangerous building, so that the safety of rescue personnel is ensured, the water spraying assemblies spray water mist above the rescue vehicle to reduce the ambient temperature of equipment to ensure normal and stable operation of the rescue vehicle, and a scene of road obstacle is formed, and the mechanical arms are used for moving the obstacle away from the scene to facilitate rescue.

title_en: Traffic safety diagnosis and management information integrational system
title_ko: 도로교통 안전진단 및 관리를 위한 통합정보시스템
abstract_en: An integration information system for road traffic safety diagnosis and management is provided to reduce management costs by simplifying analysis procedure on road traffic safety diagnosis and management. An integration information system for road traffic safety diagnosis and management includes an information collection subsystem(S100), which has a data collection part(S101), a data conversion part(S102), and an integration database(S103), an information diagnosis and management subsystem(S200), which has a statistic analysis part(S201) and a safety diagnosis part(S202), and an information providing subsystem(S300), which has an inquiry and search part(S301), a user analysis part(S302), and a web server(S303). The integration information system shares files related to traffic accident and safety with the integration database, and provides easily and conveniently processed road traffic safety information to the users.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 도로교통 안전진단 및 관리를 위한 통합정보시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 기관별로 산재해 있는 도로교통안전 관련 자료들을 통합데이터베이스와 연계하고 이를 수집·가공·처리하여 관련 유관기관 및 일반 이용자들에게 도로교통안전관련 정보를 손쉽고 편리하게 제공할 수 있는 통합정보시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명의 도로교통 안전진단 및 관리를 위한 통합정보시스템구축으로 기관별로 산재해 있는 다양한 교통사고 및 안전관련 데이터베이스의 수집과 수집된 데이터베이스의 통합적 통계분석 및 안전진단, 그리고 인터넷을 통한 통계 및 분석 정보의 제공이 가능함에 따라 정보의 다양성, 유효성 및, 신속성을 극대화할 수 있다. 
       
     교통사고, 교통안전, 안전진단, 통합정보시스템, 도로교통, 안전관리

title_en: Apparatus for experiencing the virtual reality
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide a virtual reality experience apparatus, in which various virtual environments with respect to citizen safety, earthquakes, tsunamis, landslides, forest fires, building collapse, war, climate change, and various accidents that may occur at construction sites are configured with respective modules, a device for virtual experiences is implemented by selectively assembling modules on the ceiling, walls, and floor of a single frame according to the purpose of a virtual experience, and an experiencer can wear a VR device and enter the inside of the device so as to directly experience various virtual reality accidents. To this end, the present invention comprises: a frame for implementing a polyhedron; modular driving units which are fastened so as to be selectively attached or detached from respective areas that implement respective surfaces of the frame and can physically implement accident experience situations; a head mounted display (HMD) worn by an experiencer; and a control unit which controls the operation of the driving units to match the same with a virtual reality image displayed on the HMD.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 시민안전, 지진, 해일, 산사태, 산불, 건물붕괴, 전쟁, 기후변화, 건설현장에서 발생할 수 있는 각종 안전사고에 대한 다양한 가상환경을 각각 모듈로 구성하고, 가상체험을 위한 목적에 맞게 하나의 프레임의 천장, 벽체, 바닥부위에 모듈들을 선택적으로 조립하여 가상체험을 위한 장치를 구현하며, 체험자가 VR기기를 착용하여 장치의 내부로 진입하여 다양한 가상현실의 안전사고를 몸으로 직접 체험할 수 있도록 한 가상현실 체험장치를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은 다면체를 구현하기 위한 프레임; 상기 프레임의 각 면을 구현할 부위에 선택적으로 탈부착이 가능하도록 각각 체결되며, 안전사고 체험상황을 물리적으로 구현하는 모듈화된 구동부; 체험자가 착용하는 HMD; 상기 HMD에 디스플레이되는 가상현실 영상과 일치되도록 상기 구동부의 구동을 제어하는 제어부;로 구성된다.

title_en: A kind of earthquake rescue tool
abstract_en: A kind of earthquake rescue tool, including hydraulic mandril, the hydraulic mandril includes first hydraulic cylinder body, second hydraulic cylinder body, oil storage cylinder, the oil storage cylinder is connect by oil inlet pipe with first hydraulic cylinder side bottom end, the side bottom end of first hydraulic cylinder side adjacent with the second hydraulic cylinder is connected by oil inlet pipe, the second hydraulic cylinder bottom surface is equipped with flowline, the flowline is connect with the oil storage cylinder, the second hydraulic cylinder connects the position of the oil inlet pipe, higher than the position that the oil storage cylinder connects the flowline；The first hydraulic cylinder body is fixedly connected with the external wall of the second hydraulic cylinder by attachment device, and the attachment device intersects the diamond shape device formed by connecting rod.In the building collapsed of support or other blocks, two supporting points object level that allows to collapse is lifted, and is guaranteed to lift stability when collapsing object, while increasing supporting point, is expanded the mass range for lifting the object that collapses.

title_en: Rescue shovel with hoisting function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue shovel with a hoisting function, which comprises a main shovel and two auxiliary shovels, wherein a shovel lever of the auxiliary shovel is formed by hinging two short levers with same length. When the rescue shovel is used for hoisting, the shovel levers of the two auxiliary shovels are used as erector arms, a shovel lever of the main shovel is used as a hoisting screw rod, and displacement is generated at the hinged positions of the erector arms so as to realize hoisting. The rescue shovel can realize the functions of earth shoveling and hoisting by simple disassembly and assembly, and is convenient to implement person and property rescue in disasters such as earthquake, building collapse, debris flow and the like.

title_en: Smart wear for firefighting work
abstract_en: The smart helmet device for firefighting work of the present invention comprises: a helmet body worn for the protection of the head and the face of a worker; a camera unit for filming a worker or the surroundings thereof, and generating image information thereby; a sound input unit for receiving the voice of a worker or the sound of the surroundings thereof as an input, and generating sound information thereby; a control module for transmitting, to a central control center, the image information and the sound information through a smart belt, and receiving a predetermined control signal for the safety of a worker from the central control center; and a display mounted on one side of the bottom surface of the brim of the helmet body, and according to the command of the control module, displaying information processed in a smart wear or the control signal received from the central control center. The smart wear of the present invention provides a safer work environment to workers at the scene of a fire with concerns of property damage or casualties, and further guarantees the safety of disaster prevention workers from various risk factors that could arise in a work environment such as additional collapse, isolation, gas explosion, and falls.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 소방작업을 위한 스마트 헬멧장치는, 작업자의 두부와 안면보호를 위해 착용하는 헬멧 본체와, 작업자나 작업자 주변을 촬영하여 영상정보를 생성하는 카메라부와, 작업자 음성이나 작업자 주변의 사운드를 입력받고 사운드 정보를 생성하는 음향 입력부와, 상기 스마트 벨트를 통해, 상기 영상정보와 사운드 정보를 중앙통제 센터로 전송하고 중앙통제 센터로부터 작업자 안전을 위한 소정의 제어신호를 수신하는 제어모듈과, 상기 헬멧 본체의 챙 밑면 일측에 장착되며, 상기 제어모듈의 지시에 따라, 스마트 웨어에서 처리되는 정보나 중앙통제 센터로부터 수신된 상기 제어신호를 표시하는 디스플레이를 포함하여 구성된다. 본 발명에 따른 스마트 웨어는, 재산피해나 인명피해가 우려되는 화재현장의 작업자에게 보다 안전한 작업환경을 제공할 수 있게 되었으며, 현장에서 발생할 수 있는 각종 위험 요소들(예: 추가붕괴, 고립, 개스 폭발, 추락 등)로부터 방재 작업자들의 안전을 한층 보장할 수 있게 되었다.
